It includes detailed specifications for image type, reference image usage (with strict identity preservation), canvas size, title text styling, main character description, lighting, render style, and specific content for four comic panels, all set against a detailed comic book background.

prompts.title: Cinematic Wasteland Survivor Portrait (Mad Max Style)
prompts.description: A photorealistic cinematic film still prompt inspired by Mad Max: Fury Road, focusing on extreme realism and preserving the subject's exact identity and imperfections (dirt, sweat, pores). It details the subject as a wasteland survivor, holding an improvised shotgun, set in an orange desert with harsh overhead sun and strong teal & orange color grading.

prompts.title: Abandoned Promotional Statue Conversion Prompt
prompts.description: A unique prompt for converting an uploaded character image into a photorealistic, abandoned promotional statue or costume found in a dark, dusty location (like an old TV studio). It mandates preserving the original character design while rendering the figure as lifeless, dirty, and worn, illuminated only by a harsh flashlight beam, emphasizing documentary realism.

prompts.title: AI Manga: 2-Minute Cooking
prompts.description: A prompt or instruction to generate an AI manga strip focused on the theme of '2-minute cooking', created using the Nano Banana Pro tool.

prompts.title: Multi-Cut Scene Generation and Extraction Prompt
prompts.description: A two-part prompt demonstrating a technique in Nano Banana Pro to generate a multi-cut image (25 scenes) and then extract a specific scene (scene 7) at high resolution, useful for comparing multiple variations quickly.

prompts.title: Four-Angle Cinematic Panel Composition
prompts.description: A complex prompt designed to generate a single cinematic image divided into four horizontal panels, each showing the same scene and subject from a different camera angle: bird’s-eye, side close-up, extreme close-up, and medium wide back shot. This is intended for high-end editorial film-strip compositions.

prompts.title: AI Manga Nano Banana Pro
prompts.description: This tweet showcases an AI-generated manga created using the Nano Banana Pro model, featuring a cat character.

prompts.title: Dramatic cinematic forest clash scene
prompts.description: A prompt for generating a dramatic cinematic scene set in a dark, foggy forest, depicting two hooded figures clashing, with one unleashing a burst of glowing red energy, emphasizing deep shadows, dense atmosphere, and high-detail lighting.

prompts.title: Ordinary Object as Desperate Refuge During Catastrophe
prompts.description: A conceptual prompt for generating a dramatic scene where an ordinary object is used as a desperate refuge by tiny human beings during a raging catastrophic storm. The prompt emphasizes claustrophobic interior lighting, visible storm elements through gaps, and the emotional tension of deciding whether to stay or flee.

prompts.title: 4-Panel Tennis Couple Storyboard Prompt
prompts.description: A complex JSON prompt for generating a four-panel vertical storyboard collage of a tennis couple during golden hour, emphasizing cinematic lifestyle, specific panel compositions, and strict adherence to uploaded reference images for style and identity.

prompts.title: Cinematic Ottoman Historical Romance Prompt
prompts.description: A highly detailed JSON prompt for generating an ultra-photorealistic cinematic film still of a couple in late Ottoman era clothing on a stormy coastline, focusing on period accuracy, emotional intensity, and dramatic natural lighting.

prompts.title: Cinematic Female Warrior Portrait Prompt
prompts.description: A highly detailed prompt for generating a standard, mid-shot portrait of a female warrior inspired by Mulan, emphasizing cinematic quality, realistic textures, dramatic lighting, and a specific mood for high-end fantasy imagery.

prompts.title: Creating a Geography Manga about Poland
prompts.description: A user outlines a structured prompt for Nano Banana Pro (via Gemini Pro) to create a geography manga about Poland. The prompt defines the design structure and uses an attached image as the main visual reference.

prompts.title: AI Art Experiment: Speech Bubbles and Hand-Drawn Text
prompts.description: An AI art experiment using Nanobanana to incorporate speech bubbles and hand-drawn text, treating the text as a sound effect in the prompt. The user notes the generation is unstable but likes the manga-like expression.

prompts.title: Daily Drawing: Hasuka-chan Manga
prompts.description: A prompt used with nanobanana pro to create a manga featuring the character Hasuka-chan as part of the user's daily drawing routine.

prompts.title: Google Nano Banana Manga: One Person and Three Animals
prompts.description: A prompt used to generate a manga story titled 'One Person and Three Animals' using Google Nano Banana. The story follows a solo adventurer who successively recruits companion animals, drawing inspiration from the Momotaro folk tale.

prompts.title: Varied Combat Scene Rough Sketch Prompt
prompts.description: A second, more complex image generation prompt for NanoBananaPro, building on the previous one. This prompt aims to generate multiple, differing attack and defense scenarios within the same image, maintaining the style of a fierce, shonen manga-like hand-to-hand fight rendered as a rough pencil sketch.

prompts.title: Image-to-Comic Style Conversion Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt instructing the AI to convert a given picture into a trending comic style page. Crucially, it mandates preserving the face and dress while adding different comic panels and effects.

prompts.title: Four-Panel Manga Creation about Lovart App
prompts.description: A detailed, multi-step prompt for generating a four-panel manga (yonkoma) using the Nano Banana Pro model, specifically illustrating a scenario where a female protagonist uses the Lovart app during a short break (poikatsu) to quickly create content. The prompt specifies character actions, dialogue, and panel layout.

prompts.title: Cyberpunk Tech Visual Storyboard for Mac Mini Branding
prompts.description: This is a prompt for generating a 3x3 visual storyboard for Mac mini branding, specifically requesting a cyberpunk technology style.

prompts.title: Nano Banana Comic Prompt: Elf and Human Love Comedy
prompts.description: A detailed multi-panel prompt for generating a four-panel vertical manga (yonkoma) using Nano Banana, focusing on a modern fantasy/romantic comedy scenario. The prompt specifies the genre, format, art style (bright, expressive, no grayscale), setting (modern Japanese city), and clothing. It includes specific scene descriptions for each of the four panels, detailing character placement, actions, expressions, and the exact dialogue for a humorous interaction between an elf woman and a human man concerning a discontinued mobile game.

prompts.title: 16:9 Cinematic Storyboard from References
prompts.description: A Chinese prompt for generating a 16:9 cinematic storyboard (four continuous panels) in a realistic documentary style. It uses two reference images: one for composition, relationship, and style, and another for the character's appearance, detailing specific camera angles and scene elements for each panel, such as a snowy outdoor view and a narrow room perspective.

prompts.title: Grok Instruction for Generating Nano Banana Pro Image Prompts
prompts.description: This is an instruction given to the Grok LLM to generate a set of five keyframe image prompts suitable for Nano Banana Pro, based on an existing video generation prompt (which is referenced but not included here). This is a meta-prompt for prompt engineering.

prompts.title: DVD Screengrab of Ominous Korean Horror Movie
prompts.description: A short, specific prompt requesting an image in the style of a DVD screengrab from a 2001 Korean horror movie. The scene is an ominous, very dark domestic dinner involving a giant man, with the explicit instruction that the proportions should be 'all wrong' and no text overlays should be visible.

prompts.title: E-Konte (Japanese Storyboard) Generation
prompts.description: This tweet describes the capability of Nano Banana Pro to create an e-konte (Japanese style storyboard) based on a given scene description, indicating a feature for visual narrative planning.

prompts.title: Transformer Robot to Tank Transition Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt for generating a 6-step transitional process image, showing a Transformer robot transforming into a tank. It specifies a 3x2 layout and requires maintaining the same style without outlines.

prompts.title: Wizardry x Genba Neko Collaboration Image
prompts.description: A user generated a 'Wizardry x Genba Neko' (site cat) collaboration image using Nano Banana, specifically requesting a 'cat-human character.' The resulting image shows the character giving an 'OK' sign, which required five fingers and paw pads, highlighting a specific AI output characteristic.

prompts.title: Prompt for Visual Storyboard Creation
prompts.description: A call to action for users to receive a prompt designed to create a brand visual storyboard for product presentation using Nano Banana Pro, often shared upon request.

prompts.title: 2000s OVA Style High School Girl Monster Hunt
prompts.description: A detailed, multi-part prompt designed for Nano Banana Pro to generate a four-panel sequence in the style of a 2000s Japanese Anime OVA. The scene depicts two high school girls confronting amorphous, liquid-based monsters in a deserted city at night, focusing on tension and composition.

prompts.title: 9-Panel Product Storyboard Mockup Prompt
prompts.description: A highly structured prompt designed to generate a 3x3 storyboard grid for a high-end product branding portfolio. It mandates using a reference image for product consistency across all nine panels and specifies unique composition, focus, and setting for each frame, emphasizing form, composition, and visual rhythm over realism.

prompts.title: Detailed Storyboard Prompt for Brand Visuals
prompts.description: A highly detailed, multi-frame prompt designed for Nano Banana Pro to generate a clean, professional 3x3 storyboard grid for a branding portfolio. It emphasizes consistency in product identity, color, and ratio across all nine frames, focusing on composition, material, and visual rhythm rather than narrative.

prompts.title: Storyboard Grid Generation Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt used to convert an existing image (presumably uploaded or referenced) into a storyboard grid format using Nano Banana Pro.

prompts.title: AI Manga Theme: Trial and Error
prompts.description: A user created an AI manga using Nano Banana Pro with the theme 'Trial and Error', discussing the process of experimenting with parameters and instructions to discover new uses for the tool.

prompts.title: Gemini Nano Banana Pro 4-Panel Manga: Remote Control Episode
prompts.description: A 4-panel manga about daily life, titled 'Banbi & SMA Mom Remote Control Episode', created using Gemini's Nano Banana Pro. The user notes that while Japanese text conversion still has issues, the feature is very convenient.

prompts.title: Commercial Ad Storyboard Prompt for Luxury Luggage
prompts.description: A structured prompt designed to generate a 3x3 grid storyboard for a luxury luggage commercial. The prompt focuses on maintaining character consistency (a woman and man) across nine images depicting emotional highs and lows, culminating in an elegant shot with the brand logo.

prompts.title: YAML Template for Web Manga Creation using Gemini (Nano Banana Pro)
prompts.description: A comprehensive YAML-based prompt template designed for Gemini (referred to as Nano Banana Pro) to generate a four-tier web manga strip. It includes strict adherence rules for character consistency, detailed style guides (lighting, background, dialogue bubbles, visual effects), and a structured storyboard format for defining scenes and dialogue in each panel.

prompts.title: 10+ Page Manga Creation Prompt
prompts.description: This entry refers to a publicly shared, free-to-use prompt template for creating a manga of over 10 pages using Nano Banana Pro. It is intended as a reference for generating comic-style illustrations.

prompts.title: Transform Photo into 4 Dynamic Character Styles
prompts.description: A prompt instructing the model to transform an original photo into four different photorealistic, ultra-detailed character styles. It specifies a mid-close-up, wide-angle shot with extreme, dynamic camera angles and powerful poses, requiring the original photo as input.

prompts.title: Real People Transforming into Comic Characters in a Future City
prompts.description: A Japanese prompt used with Gemini (Nano Banana Pro) and DeeVid AI for video generation. The prompt describes a scenario where real men and women are sucked into a comic book, transform into comic characters, and strike a final pose against a futuristic city background. This is an example of a complex narrative prompt for AI video.

prompts.title: Subtle Cyborg Transformation in Subway
prompts.description: A highly detailed prompt for generating an ultra-realistic cinematic film still of a woman in a moving subway train, focusing on a subtle, early-stage cyborg transformation (faint bioluminescent circuitry, mechanical glint in one eye) and a tense, grounded sci-fi realism aesthetic.

prompts.title: Frank Miller Sin City Graphic Novel Style Transfer
prompts.description: A prompt designed to transform subjects from an uploaded image into the stark, high-contrast aesthetic of Frank Miller's Sin City graphic novels. It mandates deep shadows, heavy cross-hatching, thick ink outlines, and dramatic chiaroscuro lighting against a void background.

prompts.title: Selfie to Claymation Transformation
prompts.description: A prompt used with Nano Banana Pro to transform a selfie into a claymation style, focusing on realistic clay texture, visible fingerprints, and the warmth of stop-motion animation. The prompt is shared in the second image of the tweet.

prompts.title: Indie Film Aesthetic Narrative Grid Prompt
prompts.description: A complex, structured JSON prompt designed to generate a 5-image narrative grid with an experimental indie film aesthetic. It focuses on a quiet, nostalgic moment of a young man at an abandoned bus stop, emphasizing raw realism, low contrast, and imperfect composition to simulate a remembered scene.

prompts.title: Combat Scene Generation Comparison
prompts.description: This is a prompt used to generate a combat scene, comparing the output quality between GPT-image and Nano Banana Pro, using the same prompt and reference image.

prompts.title: Negative Prompting for Manga Generation in NanoBanana Pro
prompts.description: A template for 'Forbidden Items' (negative prompts) specifically tailored for generating manga panels in NanoBanana Pro, ensuring correct reading order, language, and format.

prompts.title: LEGO Miniature Diorama of 'The Nun' Horror Film Set
prompts.description: A creative JSON prompt for generating a LEGO miniature diorama scene depicting the film set of the horror movie 'The Nun'. It includes detailed descriptions of the gothic stone interior, the LEGO nun character, and various LEGO minifigure crew members (camera operator, boom mic, director) interacting with film equipment, all rendered with dramatic, high-contrast cinematic lighting.

prompts.title: Heroine Expression Difference Grid Attempt
prompts.description: A Japanese prompt attempting to use Nano Banana Pro to generate a 16-panel grid showing different facial expressions (expression differences) of a heroine, based on a reference image. The prompt specifies that the top-left panel should be the original image, and the remaining 15 panels should show variations while maintaining the art style, similar to pseudo-reference functionality in older models.

prompts.title: Ultra-Photorealistic Cinematic Couple Triptych Storyboard
prompts.description: A highly constrained JSON prompt designed to generate a triptych (three vertical panels) of a couple on a swing set, requiring strict identity locking for both subjects and an exact composition lock based on a reference image. The prompt specifies ultra-photorealistic rendering, cinematic lighting (28mm lens, f/2.8), and detailed constraints to ensure the action (upside-down hanging, pushing) and faces are perfectly preserved across all three panels.

prompts.title: Kaiju Kitten Destroying Sydney Waterfront
prompts.description: A simple, creative prompt structure for generating an image of a massive kaiju kitten destroying a specific urban landmark, viewed from a ground-level perspective under bright daylight.

prompts.title: Urban Fantasy Giantess Taylor Swift with Scaffolding
prompts.description: A complex, surreal prompt to generate a hyper-realistic, cinematic image of a colossal Taylor Swift standing in a city street, surrounded by construction scaffolding and miniature construction workers, emphasizing scale and urban fantasy aesthetics.

prompts.title: High-Energy, Print-Ready Comic Art Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt designed to generate non-photorealistic, high-energy comic book art. It specifies bold outlines, vibrant colors, dramatic action, and explicitly excludes photos or realism, aiming for a pure, print-ready comic style.

prompts.title: Surreal Forced Perspective Composite Prompt for Nano Banana Pro
prompts.description: A prompt for Nano Banana Pro to create a hyper-realistic, surreal composite image using forced perspective. It features an extreme close-up of a man's astonished face and hand, cradling a tiny, miniature version of a man, emphasizing 8k Octane Render fidelity and skin texture.

prompts.title: Gemini System Prompt for 10-Page Manga Generation in Nano Banana Pro
prompts.description: A detailed system prompt template designed for Gemini to act as a professional manga writer and AI art director. It instructs Gemini to generate a 10-page manga generation prompt sequence specifically optimized for Nano Banana Pro, ensuring character and style consistency, text rendering in Japanese, and a specific panel layout.

prompts.title: Nostalgic Memory Narrative Grid Prompt
prompts.description: A complex, multi-shot prompt designed to generate a 5-image narrative grid with an experimental indie film aesthetic, focusing on a young man in an abandoned bus stop at late evening. The prompt emphasizes low contrast, desaturated colors, intentional imperfection, and a focus on atmosphere over sharpness to evoke a sense of memory and emotional restraint.

prompts.title: Complex Comic Panel Generation: Speech Bubbles and Identity Separation
prompts.description: A prompt challenge for Nano Banana Pro focused on generating a comic panel that requires complex handling of nested speech bubbles, specifying which character speaks which line, and differentiating between three versions of the same person (Real, Angel, Demon) within the same frame.

prompts.title: Cinematic Anime/Reality Action Blend Prompt
prompts.description: A highly technical, structured prompt for Nano Banana Pro designed to blend a photorealistic live-action person (from a reference image) with a cel-shaded anime character in a single cinematic frame. The prompt enforces strict rules for identity preservation, scale matching, camera settings, and consistent lighting (stormy maritime noir) to ground the anime character realistically within the live-action environment.

prompts.title: Gemini 3 Story Creation and Nano Banana Pro Manga Generation
prompts.description: A two-part prompt sequence for creating a four-panel manga. The first prompt is for Gemini 3 (in 'thought mode') to generate a story. The second prompt uses the generated story text and instructs Gemini 3 + Nano Banana Pro to create a rich, four-panel manga with a cute, pop art style, specifying character and panel layout.

prompts.title: High-Concept 3D Diorama Generation Prompt
prompts.description: A system instruction prompt for an AI to act as a visual artist and content generator, tasked with creating high-concept 3D dioramas based on movies or games, visualizing a famous level inside a hollowed-out item related to the title.

prompts.title: Classic Comic Book Panel Style
prompts.description: A JSON prompt detailing the visual style for generating an image in a classic comic book panel format. It specifies a limited, flat color palette, bold black ink outlines, and cel-shading, depicting a man with a mustache and sunglasses relaxing in a pool.

prompts.title: Lara Croft with Fiery Bow in Heavy Downpour
prompts.description: An image generation prompt for a cinematic medium shot of Lara Croft in a heavy nighttime downpour. The focus is on the dramatic lighting provided by a fiery recurve bow she is holding, with mud and water splattering her face, conveying intense focus.

prompts.title: Nosferatu Cinematic 2x2 Grid Prompt
prompts.description: A highly detailed prompt for generating a 2x2 cinematic grid composition featuring two characters (Mia Goth and Bill Skarsgård as Nosferatu), maintaining strict consistency in lighting, wardrobe, and environment across all four panels. The prompt describes four specific, intimate, and predatory moments, emphasizing photorealism, gold ornamentation, and dramatic cinematic lighting.

prompts.title: Profile 4-Panel Manga Generation
prompts.description: The user used Nano Banana Pro to generate a 4-panel manga based on their profile. The resulting image was in a pixel art style, confirming that the tool can handle that aesthetic when requested.

prompts.title: Generating 4-Panel Manga on GE's Financial History
prompts.description: A user describes generating a 4-panel manga using Nano Banana Pro about the history of GE's financial business, from entry to withdrawal. The process involved asking the LLM for the flow of events and then instructing it to summarize it into a 4-panel format.

prompts.title: Advanced 10-Page Manga Generation Prompt (LLM System Prompt)
prompts.description: An extensive system prompt for Gemini, acting as a 'Professional Manga Writer' and 'AI Art Director,' designed to generate a 10-page full-color manga using NanoBananaPro. The prompt includes strict rules for consistency, such as fixing character and art style definitions across all pages, mandatory use of Japanese language, 9:16 vertical aspect ratio, and explicit instructions for text rendering (dialogue and sound effects) within the image. It also mandates a specific panel layout (4-8 panels per page) and story structure (hook on Page 1, punchline on Page 10).

prompts.title: High-Altitude Mountaineering Cinematic Collage Prompt
prompts.description: A detailed, structured prompt designed to generate a four-panel photojournalistic collage depicting high-altitude mountaineering in extreme conditions, focusing on visual elements, atmosphere, and technical specifications to emphasize the scale and hostility of the environment.

prompts.title: Anime Style Keyframe Prompt for Music Video Scene Generation
prompts.description: A structured prompt template for Nano Banana Pro designed to generate individual frames (key frames) for a music video (MV) in an anime style. It includes detailed style constraints, negative prompts, aspect ratio, and a section for defining specific scene prompts and character references.

prompts.title: Dynamic Manga Page Layout Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt designed to generate a complete Japanese manga page with a dynamic and varied panel layout, specifying six panels of different sizes and shapes to create visual tension and movement, set in a Sapporo winter cityscape, using ultra-thin linework and screentone shading.

prompts.title: Raw Reality TV Broadcast Screenshots (2x2 Grid)
prompts.description: A complex, structured prompt designed to generate a 2x2 grid of images mimicking raw, unpolished TV broadcast footage, specifically in the style of a reality show like Big Brother. It mandates on-screen graphics (timestamps, camera IDs) and specific visual aesthetics for four different scenes: Domestic Friction, Confessional Booth, Night Vision Secrets, and The Explosion.

prompts.title: Hyper-realistic crossover image of Zenitsu Agatsuma from Demon Slayer
prompts.description: A detailed, hyper-realistic prompt for Nano Banana Pro that generates an image of Zenitsu Agatsuma from the anime 'Demon Slayer' stepping out of a giant physical manga book, blending the 8K photo-realistic world with the black-and-white manga panel style.

prompts.title: Nano Banana Pro Storyboard Prompt Pattern
prompts.description: This is a prompt pattern designed for Nano Banana Pro to generate storyboards. The user is instructed to use this pattern and only change the scene description for each panel to maintain consistency across the storyboard.

prompts.title: Nano Banana Pro 4-Panel Comic Explanation
prompts.description: A prompt instructing an AI to create a four-panel comic strip explaining the 'Nano Banana Pro' product, utilizing a specified character for the illustration.

prompts.title: Ink Noir Portrait Generation Prompt
prompts.description: A detailed image generation prompt designed for a high-contrast ink noir portrait. It specifies the use of expressive black ink strokes and controlled splatter, emphasizing heavy shadows and selective highlights created through negative space. The goal is to achieve a moody, cinematic, graphic novel aesthetic.

prompts.title: Structured Prompt for Automated Manga Generation
prompts.description: A structured prompt template used in a pipeline combining Claude and Nano Banana Pro to automatically generate cooking manga. It defines parameters for the scene, characters, dialogue, and specific prompts for both the manga panel and the real-life cooking image.

prompts.title: Style Transfer for Cinematic Live-Action Keyframes
prompts.description: A straightforward prompt used for style transfer, instructing the model to convert a set of keyframes (presumably from a movie clip) into a realistic live-action cinematic style. The key instruction is to maintain the exact grid layout and cell positions from the input image.

prompts.title: Documentary Style Image Generation with Nano Banana Pro
prompts.description: This prompt template is designed for Nano Banana Pro to generate images in the style of a documentary TV program, complete with split-screen scenes (2x2 grid), superimposed text (telop), and picture-in-picture (wipe). Users upload a person's photo and then use this prompt, customizing the documentary's theme to create different scenarios, such as a '24-hour ramen shop' or 'former idol working in a local factory.'

prompts.title: Generating Rich 4-Panel Manga with NanoBanana Pro
prompts.description: A simple prompt for NanoBanana Pro to quickly create a rich, 4-panel manga strip based on a provided text. The prompt specifies a cute, pop art style, characters, and panel layout, making it useful for generating content like manga advertisements or landing page comics.

prompts.title: Behind-the-Scenes Selfie Identity Swap Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt for generating a photorealistic image where the subject's identity and outfit are preserved from a reference image, but the background is replaced with a chaotic, real behind-the-scenes set from the movie 'Léon: The Professional'. The subject, Léon, and Mathilda are taking a selfie together amid crew members and filming equipment.

prompts.title: Four-Panel Manga Creation Prompt (Version 2 with Formatting)
prompts.description: An updated version of the manga generation prompt, adding specific formatting requirements: all dialogue must be in vertical Japanese text, speech bubbles must progress from right to left, and clarifying that 'gibasa' is a dialectal name for 'akamoku'.

prompts.title: Character Breaking Out of a Comic Book
prompts.description: A prompt for an ultra-realistic cinematic scene where a real human character bursts dynamically out of a giant open comic book lying on the floor. The prompt specifies preserving only the facial identity from a reference image while detailing the character's outfit, the messy aesthetic room environment, and the blend of comic art and reality.

prompts.title: 1-Minute Challenge: Setsubun Manga
prompts.description: A user completed the 'Nano Banana Pro 1-Minute Challenge' by generating a short manga about Setsubun (Bean-Throwing Festival), suggesting that SNS-bound manga can now be created in just one minute.

prompts.title: Cinematic Storyboard Contact Sheet Prompt for Nano Banana Pro
prompts.description: This is an image generation prompt designed for Nano Banana Pro to create a 3x3 cinematic storyboard contact sheet. It details a sequence featuring a young woman in a frozen alpine winter setting, specifying the arrangement of nine distinct panels, including close-ups, medium shots, and wide shots, all unified by a moody blue-hour twilight aesthetic and high-quality film photography style.

prompts.title: Cinematic 12-Panel Timeline of a Subject's Epic Day
prompts.description: This is a detailed image generation prompt designed to create a 12-panel (4x3) cinematic timeline. It captures an epic, chaotic, or hilarious day in the life of a specified subject, complete with timestamps, punchy captions, and richly detailed scenes. The overall visual UI, backdrop, and panel frames are themed to match the subject's universe, such as arcane scrolls for wizards or chrome HUD for cyborgs.

prompts.title: Daily Nano: Playing with Shadows 4-Panel Comic
prompts.description: This tweet shares a 4-panel comic created using the Nano Banana Pro tool, centered around the theme of 'playing with shadows.' The comic aims to bring a little chuckle to the reader in the final panel.

prompts.title: 16:9 Contact Sheet Generation from Reference Image
prompts.description: A prompt for generating a stacked contact sheet of 16:9 aspect ratio images, derived from an original uploaded picture, featuring close-ups of the characters and a final panel showing a phone screen recording audio, while respecting the original image's details and lighting.

prompts.title: Cinematic Storyboard of Woman and Bear in Forest
prompts.description: A prompt for generating a 3x3 grid storyboard collage featuring a young woman in traditional patterned clothing sitting beside a large, calm bear in a misty mountain forest. The style is highly realistic, cinematic, and emphasizes detailed textures and golden hour lighting.

prompts.title: Nano Banana Pro Prompt for Generating 'Viral Diagrams'
prompts.description: An announcement about an updated guide that includes a 'secret prompt' for generating 'viral diagrams' instantly using Gemini 'Nano Banana Pro,' along with prompts for creating diagram bots and four-panel comics.

prompts.title: IT Education Manga Generation Prompt
prompts.description: A user is testing Nano Banana Pro's ability to create educational manga, specifically focusing on the concept of Microsoft Azure subscriptions. The results and prompt details are shared in a linked note.

prompts.title: Style Change Prompt for Damaged Areas: Lost Love Girls
prompts.description: Part of a 'Tennen's Prompt Festival' series, this prompt is designed to change the art style specifically in damaged or torn areas of an image, originally intended for illustrations and likely compatible with realistic images.

prompts.title: Detective Evidence Board Generation
prompts.description: A prompt designed to generate a visual concept of a detective's evidence board, simulating an obsessive, late-night noir atmosphere. It details the cork board's contents: polaroids, maps, newspaper clippings, sticky notes, and red string connecting the evidence, emphasizing dramatic shadows from a single bare bulb and realistic clutter like coffee stains.

prompts.title: Existential Cinematic Solitude Film Still
prompts.description: A prompt for creating a cinematic film still drenched in emotional weight, inspired by 1970s existential cinema (Vilmos Zsigmond). It focuses on profound solitude, cold blue hour lighting, rain-streaked glass distortions, and a muted, desaturated palette, using technical details like analog grain and ray-traced reflections to create crushing atmospheric pressure.

prompts.title: Gemini Nano Banana Pro 3.0 Stranger Things Edition Prompt
prompts.description: This prompt is designed for the 'Gemini Nano Banana Pro 3.0' model, specifically for generating content related to the 'Stranger Things' theme. The prompt instructs the model to create a story or scenario where a {argument name="character name" default="young boy"} discovers a mysterious {argument name="object" default="glowing orb"} in the woods, setting the stage for a supernatural adventure.

prompts.title: Glass Shard Character Embedding Prompt (Comparison)
prompts.description: A prompt designed to test the AI's ability to generate a complex composition: depicting separate figures within each individual shard of flying broken glass. The user compares ChatGPT's output (which looked like paper scraps) against Nano Banana Pro's output, concluding that Nano Banana Pro was superior in understanding the physical constraints of embedding characters within glass shards.

prompts.title: Nano Banana Pro Manga Generation Prompt with Character Consistency Rules
prompts.description: A detailed system prompt for Nano Banana Pro aimed at generating manga pages while strictly maintaining character consistency based on an uploaded reference image. It includes specific rules for fixing character features (hair, eyes, clothing) as 'master data,' applying a chibi style only to body proportions, and enforcing strict rules for natural Japanese dialogue and camera work to avoid monotony.

prompts.title: Multi-Step Comic Generation with MJ and Nano Banana Pro
prompts.description: A two-step process for generating high-quality comic content. First, use Midjourney (MJ) to create a visually appealing base image, and then use Nano Banana Pro to generate character expressions and scene variations based on that image. This method aims to elevate the aesthetic quality of AI-generated comics.

prompts.title: Manga Page: Dragon Ball Z Fusion Technique
prompts.description: A simple prompt for generating a manga page illustration showing two user-defined characters performing the Dragon Ball Z fusion technique and revealing their combined form.

prompts.title: Eraser Gun Style Prompt for Nano Banana Pro (Fighting Pose Stage)
prompts.description: A multi-stage prompt designed to generate a character performing an 'Eraser Gun' style energy wave attack, similar to Dragon Ball techniques. This is the first stage prompt, which changes the character's pose to a fighting stance while strictly preserving the original art style from a reference image.

prompts.title: Superhero Comic Book Pop Art Diorama Prompt
prompts.description: A detailed prompt for generating a pop art-style image of a superhero (like Iron Man) bursting out of a graphic novel page in 3D, set on a messy desk environment. It uses comic book aesthetics like cel-shading and halftone patterns.

prompts.title: Manga creation prompt for Nano Banana Pro
prompts.description: The user mentions constructing a detailed prompt for Nano Banana Pro to generate high-quality manga panels, indicating that the full, long prompt is provided in the replies (which are not available here, so the prompt is based on the main tweet's context).

prompts.title: Medieval Illuminated Manuscript of The Matrix Characters
prompts.description: A creative prompt that re-imagines characters from The Matrix (Neo, Morpheus, Trinity) as figures in a medieval illuminated manuscript. Neo is depicted as a saintly figure in velvet robes, flanked by the others as cloaked scholars, with the digital rain motif replaced by ornate gothic borders and calligraphic text on a gold leaf and vellum background.

prompts.title: Stranger Things Cinematic Scene: Steve vs. Vecna
prompts.description: A highly specific, cinematic prompt inspired by the TV show Stranger Things. It details a dramatic scene in the Upside Down featuring Steve Harrington suspended in mid-air with an emotional expression, and Vecna silently controlling the moment. It requires two reference images for the characters and focuses on emotional lighting, hyper-real detail, and a dark horror drama style.

prompts.title: Generate manga from plot, dialogue, and paneling
prompts.description: The user notes that Nano Banana Pro can generate manga panels based on a simple plot, dialogue, and panel division instructions, although the resulting Japanese text might sometimes be slightly unnatural.

prompts.title: Psychic Woman in Underground Lab Cinematic Scene
prompts.description: A highly cinematic and detailed prompt for generating a photorealistic scene inspired by Hawkins Lab (Stranger Things). It features a young psychic woman generating a dense, crackling sphere of red-orange energy, causing lab equipment to levitate and glass to fracture, emphasizing dramatic lighting, high contrast, and psychological tension.

prompts.title: Character Inner Monologue Comic Prompt (Japanese)
prompts.description: A complex, multi-step prompt template designed for Nano Banana Pro to generate a Japanese comic panel visualizing a character's 'inner monologue' or 'brainstorming session.' It requires user input for character settings and a dilemma, then automatically assigns roles (Optimistic, Pessimistic, Logical, My-Pace) to four mini-characters (chibi-style) who appear above the main character's head, each with a specific pose and dialogue bubble.

prompts.title: Character Rehabilitation Scene Generation Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt used with Gemini (Nano Banana Pro) to generate an image of a character in a hospital setting, which was then used to create a video with Grok Imagine. The prompt specifies the character's design must remain unchanged and describes a scene of the character rehabilitating in a hospital corridor.

prompts.title: Comic Book Page Generation
prompts.description: A simple, high-level instruction prompt for the AI to generate a comic book page, implying the AI should handle the layout, panels, and content based on a script provided by Gemini.

prompts.title: Character Hospital Scene Generation Prompt
prompts.description: A simple prompt for Nano Banana Pro instructing it to generate a scene based on an uploaded character image. The scene depicts the left character hospitalized and resting in bed, while the right character sits nearby, looking worriedly at the patient. It emphasizes maintaining the original character design, color, and style.

prompts.title: Manga Composition Prompt (LLM/Text)
prompts.description: A prompt used within Google's Opal to instruct the LLM to create the structural composition (storyboard/layout) for a 4-panel manga, which is then passed to Nano Banana Pro for actual image generation.

prompts.title: Game/Book Diorama Concept Generator
prompts.description: A system prompt instructing the AI to act as a world-class visual artist and content generator. Its task is to analyze the core identity of a game or book and construct a high-concept diorama inside a hollowed-out, context-appropriate shell. The diorama must feature miniature elements, assets, and characters from a famous level or scene, with lighting and style matching the source material.

prompts.title: Nano Banana Pro Multi-Panel Generation
prompts.description: This tweet describes the capability of Nano Banana Pro to generate multiple outputs (a 4-panel comic, a post-apocalyptic movie poster, and a photorealistic scene) from a single input image and minimal text prompts, demonstrating high control over style and content.

prompts.title: Cuckoo Clock Inspired Literary Mechanism Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt for generating a photorealistic image of a complex, hand-carved wooden mechanism, similar to a cuckoo clock but built into a classic book base. It features two panels: one depicting Don Quixote with a windmill, and the other depicting a Brutalist watchtower from 1984, emphasizing woodcraft textures, warm lighting, and a deep forest green seamless background.

prompts.title: Four-Panel Emotion Grid Generator (Joy, Anger, Sadness, Fun)
prompts.description: A detailed prompt for Nano Banana Pro to automatically generate a four-panel composition (2x2 grid) showing a consistent character (based on an uploaded image) expressing four different emotions: Joy, Anger, Sadness, and Fun. It specifies camera angles, expressions, body language, and lighting for each panel while maintaining identity consistency.

prompts.title: Multi-Angle Scene Generation Prompt (Oshi no Ko Style)
prompts.description: A Japanese prompt designed for multi-angle shot generation based on an uploaded image, creating a 2x2 grid of scenes. The narrative describes a sequence of actions involving a senior colleague (senpai) in a bookstore reacting playfully to the photographer pressing a remote button, complete with specific dialogue and social media text overlays (テロップ). This prompt is highly specific to the 'Oshi no Ko' (推しの子) aesthetic or theme.

prompts.title: Cinematic Action Scene Identity Preservation Prompt
prompts.description: A highly specific and intense prompt for Nano Banana Pro designed to generate an ultra-realistic cinematic action scene frozen at the peak of chaos. It requires strict identity preservation of an uploaded male face, placing him in the extreme foreground lunging toward the camera in panic while clutching a panicking tabby cat. The background features a massive explosion in a stadium environment, utilizing dramatic lighting (firelight, blue strobes) and hyper-detailed realism.

prompts.title: Kamehameha Attack Image Generation (Technical Prompt)
prompts.description: A highly detailed, technical prompt structure for Nano Banana Pro (v1.2) designed to generate an image of a character charging an energy attack (Kamehameha), focusing heavily on technical specifications like camera angles, lighting, visual effects (plasma energy ball, lens flare), and precise coordinate placement for manga-style speech bubbles ('か...め...は...め...'). The user compares this technical approach (their own) to a more narrative/script-based approach (borrowed prompt).

prompts.title: Japanese Text and Layout Comparison Prompt (3-Panel Manga)
prompts.description: A detailed prompt designed to test the Japanese text rendering and layout capabilities of GPTs Image 1.5 versus Nano Banana Pro. It specifies a 3-panel horizontal manga format, character consistency, and requires precise, uncorrupted Japanese text within speech bubbles, comparing the strengths of each model.

prompts.title: Cinematic Contact Sheet Generation from Reference Image
prompts.description: A complex, multi-step prompt designed to generate a cohesive 3x3 cinematic contact sheet based on an uploaded reference image. It instructs the model to internalize the scene and subject, then create a sequence of images captured from multiple distances and angles while maintaining absolute consistency in subject, location, lighting, and emotional tone.

prompts.title: New Yorker Cartoon Style PPT Illustration Prompt
prompts.description: A structured prompt designed for Nano Banana Pro to generate illustrations in the style of a New Yorker cartoonist, suitable for accompanying presentation slides (PPT). It specifies visual elements like pen and ink sketches, minimal backgrounds, metaphorical expression, and a high-contrast, limited color palette.

prompts.title: Manga Character Concept for Official System Promotion
prompts.description: A prompt for generating a manga concept focusing on a dog character created to promote an official system, who struggles with internal conflict and being caught between two sides. This was used to compare image generation quality between GPT Image 1.5 and Nano Banana Pro.

prompts.title: Archival Film Still of a Glamorous Femme Fatale

prompts.title: Simple Comic Generation Prompt

The prompt enforces character and environment consistency across all panels and specifies cinematic, photorealistic rendering with dramatic lighting (Blade Runner meets The Mandalorian style).

prompts.title: Nano Monkey's Adventure Series Manga Prompt

prompts.title: Kamehameha-Style Energy Wave Generation Prompts (Charge and Release)

prompts.title: Manual Manga Panel Generation Prompt
prompts.description: A description of a 'manual' prompt style for Nano Banana Pro, used to generate a single page of manga (manga panel output) with complex panel layouts, requiring the user to set detailed specifications themselves.

prompts.description: A prompt designed to generate a cinematic 3x3 grid showing multiple distinct camera angles of the same female subject standing beside a car at dusk, aiming for consistency and a professional cinematography reference sheet style.

prompts.description: A versatile prompt template for Nano Banana Pro designed to generate a sequence of cinematic frames (establishing shot, mid-shot, close-up) for a storytelling scene, ensuring character consistency and applying a moody, Hollywood-grade aesthetic.

prompts.title: Times Square Time-Blend Split-Screen
