The prompt focuses on a young woman (with identity lock enabled) in a dynamic action pose, from whose back a violent, glossy black, Venom-like alien symbiote is bursting, emphasizing high contrast, warm rim lighting, and dramatic low-angle framing.

prompts.title: Ultra-Detailed 3D Stylized Character Design Prompt
prompts.description: A detailed prompt for generating a Pixar/Disney-inspired 3D stylized character, focusing on soft features, expressive eyes, cozy-chic modern outfit, and high-quality rendering specifications like Octane/Arnold style and 8K resolution.

prompts.title: Cinematic fantasy silhouette art with metallic skin prompt
prompts.description: A highly structured JSON prompt for generating an epic, ultra-detailed cinematic fantasy silhouette. It specifies a regal feminine figure with metallic silver-gold skin fused with crystalline structures and gems, emerging from a dense luminous mist, emphasizing identity preservation and high contrast lighting.

prompts.title: Nano Banana Pro prompt for Cross Dimensions style
prompts.description: This is a prompt shared for the Nano Banana Pro model, specifically utilizing a 'Cross Dimensions' style, suitable for generating complex, multi-dimensional imagery.

prompts.title: LINE Sticker Generation Prompt (3D Clay Style)
prompts.description: A detailed Japanese prompt designed to generate a 3x3 grid of nine different LINE stickers featuring a 3D character in a blind box/Pop Mart style. It specifies a clay texture, matte finish, soft lighting, and nine distinct expressions, each with a cute Japanese text label and white outline.

prompts.title: Cinematic Noblewoman and Dragon Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt for generating a cinematic, hyper-realistic, high-fantasy image of a noblewoman in a medieval gown standing next to a massive grey dragon in a rocky, desolate volcanic landscape under a moody sky.

prompts.title: 8K 3D Illustration of Anthropomorphic Bees (Gym and Relaxing)
prompts.description: A complex prompt structured into two modules for generating 8K, high-end AI-generated 3D illustrations of anthropomorphic bees. The first module depicts a bee lifting weights in a natural setting, and the second shows a relaxed bee in sunglasses holding a Pepsi can on a lounge chair, emphasizing physically based rendering and extreme detail clarity.

prompts.title: Workflow for Style Transfer and Storyboard Generation
prompts.description: This is not a single prompt but a description of a multi-step workflow using Nano Banana Pro for style transfer and storyboard creation, requiring both a character image and a reference image for the desired style ('inflated' character).

prompts.title: Early 2000s Video Game Render Style Transfer
prompts.description: A text prompt designed to transform a given image into the aesthetic of an early 2000s video game render, specifically mimicking the look of Maya 4.0 rendering. It focuses on low-poly geometry, low-resolution textures, and atmospheric effects like fogging distant objects, while explicitly avoiding pixel art or voxel styles.

prompts.title: Character Turnaround Sheet Generation
prompts.description: A simple text prompt used with Nano Banana Pro to generate a three-view turnaround sheet (front, side, back) of a character based on an uploaded source image created with Stable Diffusion. This demonstrates how to quickly create character design assets.

prompts.title: Dramatic Character Transformation Prompt
prompts.description: A Nano Banana Pro prompt designed to transform an original photo into four different photorealistic, ultra-detailed character styles, using mid close-up wide-angle shots and extreme, dynamic camera angles.

prompts.title: 3D Isometric Diorama of a Household Object as Architecture
prompts.description: A prompt for generating a clean, minimal 3D isometric diorama where a specified household object is transformed into a small architectural structure. It emphasizes realistic materials, soft studio lighting, and a miniature architectural model style.

prompts.title: Generating an Isometric Room Illustration Based on a Character Concept
prompts.description: A prompt used with Nano Banana Pro to generate an isometric illustration of a room that reflects a specific character's personality, explicitly excluding the character themselves from the image.

prompts.title: 360-Degree Equirectangular Panorama Prompt
prompts.description: A highly technical prompt designed to generate a seamless 360-degree equirectangular panorama image, optimized for consistent lighting and composition across the full spherical view. It specifies a historical scene and includes rules to prevent visual artifacts like seams or directional shadows, making it ideal for virtual reality environments.

prompts.title: Lara Croft Inspired Action Editorial Portrait
prompts.description: A detailed prompt for generating a photorealistic, cinematic portrait of a blonde woman in a Lara Croft-inspired adventure heroine role, dual-wielding pistols in a jungle setting with dramatic golden hour lighting and battle-worn details.

prompts.title: 2000s Character Design Prompt
prompts.description: A simple, high-level prompt intended for the Nano Banana Pro model to generate character designs reminiscent of the 2000s aesthetic. The full, detailed prompt is implied to be in the linked image, but the core instruction is provided.

prompts.title: Transform Portrait into 3D Action Figure
prompts.description: A prompt designed for image-to-image transformation, instructing the AI to convert an uploaded portrait into a stylized 3D action figure. It specifies the style (glossy plastic toy, simplified features, big eyes) and the background (toy store shelf with blurred boxes), while requiring the main facial characteristics of the original person to remain recognizable.

prompts.title: Wingman Character Fighting Pose Generation
prompts.description: A detailed prompt for generating an image of a character from 'Wingman' in a fighting pose, based on an uploaded character sheet. It specifies faithful reproduction of details and coloring, a dynamic camera angle (diagonal side view), and a specific setting (posing on a cliff overlooking the sea). The output is requested in a realistic photo style with a 16:9 aspect ratio.

prompts.title: Cyberpunk Motorcycle Chase in Neon Megacity
prompts.description: A highly detailed, complex prompt for generating an ultra-realistic, cinematic cyberpunk scene featuring two mercenary women riding futuristic motorcycles through a rainy, neon-lit dystopian megacity. It specifies the appearance, gear, cybernetic enhancements, and dynamic poses of both the brunette and platinum blonde riders, emphasizing neon-noir atmosphere and 8K quality.

prompts.title: 3D Isometric Miniature Models of Western TV Characters
prompts.description: A prompt for generating stylized and detailed ultra-high-fidelity 3D isometric miniature models of core characters from an American Western TV series. The models are placed on city streets against a pure white background, showcasing different signature moves under soft studio lighting.

prompts.title: Hyper-Detailed Crocheted Portrait of a Legend
prompts.description: A highly detailed JSON prompt for generating an 8K hyper-detailed studio portrait in the style of handcrafted crochet or amigurumi realism. It specifies the subject's crocheted features (white yarn hair/mustache, prominent nose, open mouth with pink tongue) and attire (deep blue jacket, red bow tie), emphasizing visible tight uniform stitches and a playful, expressive mood against a dark, painterly backdrop.

prompts.title: Minimalist 3D Isometric Architectural Diorama
prompts.description: A template prompt for generating a clean, minimal 3D isometric diorama of a building section. The prompt allows customization of the building type, interior/exterior elements, and cutaway style, aiming for a miniature architectural model aesthetic with soft studio lighting and realistic materials.

prompts.title: Handcrafted Felt Miniature Scene with Tech Character
prompts.description: A highly detailed prompt for generating a macro photograph of a whimsical, handcrafted felt miniature scene. It features a soft wool doll character in minimal casual tech attire walking with a felt fox companion in a pastel, storybook environment with subtle, blurred miniature rockets in the background, emphasizing ultra-detailed felt fibers and a stop-motion animation aesthetic.

prompts.title: Isometric Miniature DJ Setup Scene
prompts.description: A prompt for generating an isometric miniature scene featuring an oversized DJ setup, utilizing the Google Gemini Nano Banana Pro model.

prompts.title: Panoramic Character Concept Sheet for 17-Year-Old Japanese JK
prompts.description: A complex prompt designed to generate a panoramic character concept decomposition sheet for a Japanese high school student (JK). It requires strict face preservation from a reference image and includes detailed sections for clothing layers, expressions, and related school items, suitable for character design workflows.

prompts.title: Nano Banana Detail Addition Test
prompts.description: A test prompt used with Nano Banana to add specific details to an existing concept or image (a 'world' the user is creating), checking the AI's ability to enhance and refine existing visual ideas.

prompts.title: Cyberpunk POV Motorcycle Ride at Hyper-Velocity
prompts.description: A cinematic, hyper-realistic prompt for generating a First-Person View (POV) image of riding a red futuristic sport motorcycle. It details the cyberpunk setting (hyperloop tunnel above a metropolis), the color palette (teal and orange), and camera effects (wide-angle lens, heavy motion blur, low shutter speed) to simulate high-velocity movement.

prompts.title: Four-View Character Reference Sheet for 3D Modeling
prompts.description: A highly specific prompt designed to create a four-view reference sheet (front, left profile, right profile, back) of a young adult woman for character design or 3D modeling purposes. It mandates a plain white background and minimal attire to clearly display detailed body proportions and muscle definition.

prompts.title: Full-Body Reference Sheet for Athletic Hourglass Figure
prompts.description: A prompt requesting a detailed, realistic full-body reference image of a woman with an athletic hourglass figure. It specifies the creation of a four-view arrangement (front, left profile, right profile, back) on a plain white background, with the subject wearing minimal black sports attire to clearly display body proportions and muscle definition.

prompts.title: Stylized 3D Glass Skeleton Render Prompt
prompts.description: A detailed text prompt for Nano Banana Pro to create a high-quality, stylized 3D render. The scene features a translucent glass skeleton wearing glasses, sitting at a wooden desk and highlighting text in an open textbook, illuminated by a warm gold desk lamp. The prompt specifies the background, clutter, and aesthetic mood.

prompts.title: Character Emerging from Smartphone Screen (Forced Perspective)
prompts.description: Two related prompts (A and B) for generating ultra-realistic images of a character emerging dynamically from a smartphone placed on a table. Both use extreme wide-angle and forced perspective to exaggerate the size of the hands and face closest to the camera, creating a 3D pop-out effect.

prompts.title: Isometric figurine generation prompt for Nano Banana Pro
prompts.description: A template prompt for generating a miniature, full-body, isometric, realistic figurine of a person based on an uploaded selfie. It allows customization of the figure's attire and action.

prompts.title: Isometric Miniature Figurine of a Character in a Japanese Flower Shop
prompts.description: A prompt designed to transform an uploaded image of a person into a realistic miniature figurine. The figurine should be full-body, isometric, and perfectly match the features of the reference image. The scene is a cute Japanese flower shop with a white background and minimal style, rendered in 4K resolution.

prompts.title: Hyper-Realistic Caricature of a Bald Man in a Jersey
prompts.description: A highly specific prompt for generating an 8K, hyper-realistic, stylized caricature figure with extremely exaggerated proportions (large head/torso, short limbs). The subject is bald, glossy-skinned, and wearing a tight white sports jersey, standing on a polished wooden table.

prompts.title: Selfie to Miniature Isometric Figurine Prompt (Simplified)
prompts.description: A simplified, versatile prompt template for Nano Banana Pro designed to transform an uploaded selfie into a miniature, full-body, isometric, realistic figurine of the person. It allows customization of the figurine's attire and action.

prompts.title: Selfie to Isometric Figurine Prompt Template
prompts.description: A simple, versatile prompt template for Nano Banana Pro designed to transform an uploaded selfie into a miniature, full-body, isometric, realistic figurine of the person. It allows customization of the figurine's attire and action.

prompts.title: Character Expression Sheet Generation (Anime Style)
prompts.description: A highly detailed, structured prompt for Nano Banana Pro designed to generate a 2x3 grid expression sheet (6 panels) of a character from a reference image. It strictly controls layout, aspect ratio, background, and ensures all elements (hair, clothing, lighting) remain identical across panels, changing only the expression.

prompts.title: Miniature Isometric Figurine Prompt for nano banana pro
prompts.description: A prompt template designed to generate a realistic, full-body, isometric miniature figurine image of a person, based on an uploaded selfie. The prompt allows customization of the figure's clothing and actions, set against a minimal white background.

prompts.title: 3D Paper Quilling Art: Samurai Warrior
prompts.description: A highly specific, structured prompt for generating an image in the style of 3D paper quilling art (paper filigree). It details the subject (Samurai Warrior in O-Yoroi armor), the construction materials (coiled paper circles, sleek paper strips), dynamic pose (Hasso-no-kamae stance), and technical camera settings (100mm Macro lens, f/11 aperture) to emphasize tactile texture and depth.

prompts.title: Epic 3D Architectural Blueprint Construction Scene
prompts.description: A highly creative prompt for generating an epic 3D scene where an architectural blueprint dynamically rises off the drafting table and transforms into a fully realized, massive building. It emphasizes extreme scale contrast, photorealism, and coexisting construction phases.

prompts.title: Pixel Art Animal Grid for APNG
prompts.description: A simple prompt for Nano Banana Pro aimed at generating a 4x4 grid of cute, colorful, pixel-art style animals on a white background. This is intended as a base for creating APNG animations.

prompts.title: Isometric Figurine from Selfie Prompt Template
prompts.description: A simple, reusable prompt template for transforming a user's selfie into a miniature, full-body, isometric, realistic figurine. The template allows customization of the figurine's clothing (ABC) and action (XYZ), set against a minimal white background in 4K resolution.

prompts.title: Plastic Model Kit Generation Prompt
prompts.description: A detailed template prompt for Nano Banana Pro to generate an image of a plastic model kit (plamo) based on a specified character, including the runner frame, a completed figure, and a package box with specific branding ('Banana Model') and technical details, designed for a photorealistic hobby product photo style.

prompts.title: Anatomy Visualization Prompt Template (Great White Shark Example)
prompts.description: A structured prompt template designed for creating incredible anatomical visualizations, specifically using glowing blue lines to map systems against a dark background. The example provided applies this template to a great white shark, highlighting its sensory anatomy (Ampullae of Lorenzini) with a pulsing red-orange glow, merging marine biology documentation with military targeting system aesthetics.

prompts.title: Generating Siblings Based on a Reference Character
prompts.description: A prompt template for Nano Banana Pro designed to generate siblings (brothers/sisters) of a character based on a provided reference illustration. It allows specifying the number of siblings and their individual characteristics (e.g., 'funky sister', 'muscle-head brother').

prompts.title: Black and White Fantasy Action Weapon Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt for generating a fantasy action scene with a focus on a large weapon and dramatic lighting. It uses specific weighting (::1.5:: and ::1.8::) to emphasize a black background, cel shading, chiaroscuro, and a red weapon trail, creating an intense, stylized combat image.

prompts.title: 3D Cartoon Character Generation Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt used to generate a cute, high-quality 3D cartoon character with child-like proportions and a playful, wholesome vibe. It specifies the use of an uploaded image for facial reference, oversized head, soft features, and a full-body render.

prompts.title: Photorealistic Battle-Damaged Mech Prompt
prompts.description: A detailed comparison between Nano Banana Pro and Seedream 4.5 for generating images of a battle-damaged mech. The prompt provided is highly descriptive, focusing on photorealism, industrial design, heavy armor, specific damage details (chipped paint, rust), and a post-apocalyptic setting with dramatic lighting.

prompts.title: Cyberpunk POV Motorcycle Ride with Vampire Mafia Girl
prompts.description: A highly technical and detailed prompt designed to generate a first-person POV shot from a high-speed motorcycle in a cyberpunk city. The scene focuses on the carbon fiber handlebars and digital readout (showing 299 km/h), with the rider being a 'Vampire Mafia Girl' whose hands are visible in tactical leather gloves. It emphasizes extreme ultra-wide-angle perspective, volumetric mist, and motion blur to suggest hyper-speed.

prompts.title: Brutalist Architecture Morphing Prompt
prompts.description: A structured prompt using weighted parameters to morph an uploaded anchor image into a monumental, post-apocalyptic brutalist architectural visualization. It focuses on geometric decay, raw concrete textures, creeping ivy, and moody, desaturated illumination.

prompts.title: Isometric 3D Diorama with Living Human Texture
prompts.description: A highly specific prompt for generating a hyper-realistic 3D isometric diorama on a circular base. The critical instruction is that the human subject must have 'Living Human Skin' texture (subsurface scattering, pores) and appear as a real person inserted into the miniature scene, maintaining perfect relative scale with props and environment.

prompts.title: Horror Author Universe Kinetic Sculptures Grid
prompts.description: A fun prompt designed to visualize the universes of four random horror authors as photorealistic miniature kinetic sculptures (automata). The prompt specifies a 2x2 grid layout, period-accurate details, soft volumetric lighting, and a premium studio look, all centered on literary-themed plinths.

prompts.title: System Prompt for 2D to 3D Plush Conversion
prompts.description: A system prompt designed to convert 2D vector graphics into highly detailed 8K 3D plush models. The prompt specifies simulating realistic fabric and stuffing physics while strictly maintaining the exact shape and color fidelity of the original 2D design, intended for use with the Nano banana pro tool.

prompts.title: Cyber-Industrial Exoskeleton Object Transformation Prompt
prompts.description: A system instruction prompt designed to reimagine any input object (like a sneaker or a skull) as a complex, high-performance Cyber-Industrial Assembly. It specifies deconstruction into segmented carbon fiber panels, internal mechanics with glowing industrial cabling, and detailed greebles, rendered as a photorealistic 3D product shot with specific studio lighting and Octane Bloom effects.

prompts.title: Warrior Woman in Chainmail Bikini Desert Scene JSON Prompt
prompts.description: A highly detailed JSON prompt for generating a photorealistic image of an athletic woman in a warrior-like kneeling stance on dusty desert terrain. It specifies strict facial identity preservation, detailed chainmail bikini armor, a Valkyrie helmet, and dramatic golden hour lighting to emphasize metallic textures and a determined expression.

prompts.title: Precure Transformation Design System Prompt
prompts.description: A detailed system prompt for Nano Banana Pro that acts as a 'Chief Designer' for a magical girl anime, taking an input character image and generating a 'Precure' transformation design. The prompt dictates every step of the design process, including motif selection, direction, color, naming conventions, hair, costume, eyes, accessories, posing, and the final catchphrase, ensuring the result fits the established Precure aesthetic.

prompts.title: 2D to 3D to VRM to Illustration Workflow
prompts.description: A complex multi-step workflow starting with a 2D reference image (two-view drawing) in Nano Banana Pro, converting it to a 3D model, then VRM, posing it, taking a screenshot, and finally using Nano Banana Pro again to convert the screenshot into an illustration style.

prompts.title: 3D Cinematic Character Render with Adaptive Magic Aura
prompts.description: A master prompt template for generating a full-body 3D cinematic render of an existing character. It strictly mandates preserving the original identity, design, and color palette from a reference image, while adding subtle, adaptive magical power effects as accents.

prompts.title: Action Figure Transformation Prompt for Nano Banana Pro
prompts.description: A comprehensive, multi-part prompt designed specifically for Nano Banana Pro to transform a reference character illustration into a highly detailed, photorealistic PVC action figure, displayed in multiple dynamic poses within a catalog-style layout.

prompts.title: Medieval Fantasy Army Camp Scene
prompts.description: This is an image generation prompt designed to create a detailed, realistic fantasy scene of a sophisticated military camp in a snowy, open clearing on the edge of a dense evergreen forest. The aesthetic is strictly Medieval/Renaissance, focusing on high organization and no technology, suitable for a world like Wheel of Time.

prompts.title: Side-by-Side Fantasy Character Design Sheet
prompts.description: A prompt for generating a side-by-side image: a close-up face and a half-body view of an identical fantasy character design. The character is a woman with dark hair, freckles, and striking blue eyes, wearing an ornate, deep-blue hooded cloak with gold patterns, blending elegance with warrior strength. It specifies a flat white background and edge lighting for depth.

prompts.title: Hyper-Realistic Robotic Frog Design
prompts.description: A prompt for generating a hyper-realistic, futuristic robotic frog with realistic proportions. The design emphasizes smooth white ceramic armor, large glossy black camera-lens eyes, and a clean, minimal composition with soft diffused lighting and a warm light gray background.

prompts.title: Pixar/Disney Style 3D Animated Character Slides
prompts.description: A set of two prompts for generating stylized 3D animated characters in the aesthetic of Pixar/Disney films. The prompts detail the character's appearance, pose, and specific environments (geometric wooden mosaic wall and rustic patchwork wall), emphasizing soft global illumination, detailed textures, and a whimsical, cozy mood.

prompts.title: Character in a Red Room Scene Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt for Nano Banana Pro to place a character (based on a reference image) into a specific, minimalist, and highly stylized room setting. The room is defined by red walls, a red floor, a simple red corner sofa, a red low table, and a large white letter 'A' written on the wallpaper, viewed as a wide shot including the room's corner.

prompts.title: Low-Poly Character Figure of Megami Device
prompts.description: A prompt for generating a low-poly image of a character figure, specifically a Megami Device model, utilizing the NanoBananaPro tool. The user notes this could be useful for creating references for low-poly character modeling.

prompts.title: Procedural Book Nook Diorama Generation Prompt
prompts.description: A highly structured, procedural prompt template designed to generate a crowded, hyper-realistic 'Book Nook' diorama based on a user-defined topic. It uses semantic analysis to define 'The Totem' and 'The Ephemera' assets, enforces a strict 90-degree corner geometry, and specifies lighting and texture contrast to create an optical illusion.

prompts.title: 3x3 Character Pose Study Grid (Sadie Sink)
prompts.description: A highly structured prompt for generating a 3x3 grid of ultra-photorealistic 3D character renders of the same subject (Sadie Sink/Wonder Woman). It mandates nine distinct, complex poses in a minimalist studio environment, focusing on high-angle perspectives, cinematic lighting, and absolute consistency across all nine frames for a professional editorial character showcase.

prompts.title: Character Generation in Tokimeki Memorial Style
prompts.description: A prompt used to generate a character in the style of the dating simulation game 'Tokimeki Memorial' using Nano Banana Pro.

prompts.title: Isometric Solarpunk Cozy Room Diorama Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt for generating a highly detailed isometric 3D render of a miniature solarpunk cozy room diorama. The style is whimsical with a clay texture finish, featuring a glass ceiling with solar panels, abundant plants, and a sleeping cat, rendered in 8k resolution using Octane.

prompts.title: 3x3 Grid Eye Expression Test Prompt (Right Image)
prompts.description: A detailed prompt designed to generate a 3x3 grid of nine images, all featuring the same girl character (from an attached image) in a close-up portrait, but with nine different, more abstract or intense Japanese eye expressions, labeled below each square.

prompts.title: Generate a beautiful woman from six different angles in a single, six-panel image
prompts.description: This is a specific instruction for the Nano Banana Pro tool, designed to generate an image of a beautiful woman shown from six different perspectives (up, down, right, left, front, back) and compile them into a single, six-panel composite image.

prompts.title: Monumental Mathematical Symbols as Terrain Typography
prompts.description: A creative image generation prompt for Nano Banana Pro, instructing it to render four monumental mathematical symbols (Integral, Sigma, Pi, Penrose Triangle) carved as colossal terrain typography in an arid landscape. The prompt specifies detailed visual elements, lighting, and composition for a photorealistic result.

prompts.title: Nano Banana Pro Model Prompt for Visuals
prompts.description: This prompt is designed to generate amazing visuals using the Nano Banana Pro model on the Higgsfield AI platform. The prompt focuses on creating a high-quality, detailed image of a futuristic, cyberpunk-style character.

prompts.title: Using Nano Banana Pro as a Shading Tool for MMD Output
prompts.description: A user experimented with using Nano Banana Pro as a shading tool to add texture, decals, and glow effects to MMD (MikuMikuDance) output. They found that adding a croquis effect to emphasize edges worked well.

prompts.title: Complex Image Generation Test Prompt for Model Coherence
prompts.description: This is a highly detailed, complex image generation prompt used to test the coherence, accuracy, and photorealism capabilities of models like Nano Banana Pro. It demands the generator accurately render numerous specific elements, precise counts (like 3 missing puzzle pieces, 23 rocks, 5 diagram panels), physics (liquid levels, centrifugal force), specific text/labels (DVORAK keyboard, presidential seal), and complex scene arrangements (people forming letters, Olympic rings, chess checkmate).

prompts.title: Live-action Lara Croft fantasy casting prompt
prompts.description: This prompt is designed for image generation models like Nano Banana Pro to create a live-action fantasy casting image of Lara Croft, focusing on a specific actress, setting, and cinematic style.

prompts.title: 2D Vector Character Illustration from Reference Image
prompts.description: A detailed prompt for generating a full-body 2D vector-style character illustration. It emphasizes accurately replicating the subject's facial structure, proportions, outfit, and pose from an uploaded reference image, ensuring a modern, minimal, and polished aesthetic with clean lines and flat shading. The final output is specified as a high-quality transparent PNG without any background.

prompts.title: Sci-Fi Cinematic Image: Man in Cryo-Chamber
prompts.description: A structured prompt for generating a high-quality, hyper-realistic cinematic image depicting a young man preserved inside a futuristic glass ice box or cryo-chamber, emphasizing cold blue lighting, frost details, and a sci-fi/cyberpunk aesthetic.

prompts.title: Freepik prompt for a futuristic nano banana
prompts.description: This is an image generation prompt for Freepik, designed to create a hyper-realistic, futuristic image of a nano banana. The prompt specifies a detailed, high-quality render with a focus on metallic textures, neon lighting, and a dark, sci-fi environment, emphasizing cinematic quality and extreme detail.

prompts.title: Character Sheet for Deep-Sea Creature with Bioluminescent Skeleton
prompts.description: A creative prompt instructing the AI to invent a new animation style and character, specifically a deep-sea creature. The prompt details the creature's appearance, featuring an iridescent oil-slick surface and a pulsing bioluminescent skeletal structure.

prompts.title: 3D Isometric Atlas Scene in Firefly Style
prompts.description: A prompt for generating an epic 3D isometric atlas scene, where a massive ancient map erupts from a scroll, transforming into a living landscape with stacked civilizations and dramatic golden-hour lighting, rendered in an 8K Unreal Engine 5 style.

prompts.title: Zootopia Style Snowman Building Scene
prompts.description: An image generation prompt for a 3D animated scene in the style of Disney/Pixar's Zootopia, featuring a rabbit and a fox building a snowman in a festive, magically lit winter holiday environment.

prompts.title: Glitch Storm Dragon Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt used to generate an image of a legendary dragon emerging from a glitch storm, utilizing pixel sorting, RGB color split, and fragmented wings to create an epic cinematic atmosphere. This prompt was tested on both Nano Banana Pro and ChatGPT.

prompts.title: Nano Banana Prompt for Heroic Low-Angle Pose with Beam Weapon
prompts.description: A detailed image generation prompt focusing on recreating a specific heroic pose using Nano Banana. The prompt specifies a dramatic low-angle shot, strong foreshortening of the legs, a powerful silhouette, and the inclusion of a beam weapon.

prompts.title: Post-Apocalyptic Survivor Cinematic Realism
prompts.description: A structured prompt for Nano Banana Pro to generate a cinematic, ultra-detailed image of a masked survivor on a burning battlefield. The focus is on intense mood, harsh lighting, and gritty texture in a post-apocalyptic setting.

prompts.title: Photorealistic Fantasy Scene: Fairy and Muscular Bear in Cavern
prompts.description: A highly detailed prompt for generating a photorealistic fantasy scene featuring a fairy woman with iridescent butterfly wings seated calmly next to a massive, muscular bear with glowing rune markings. The setting is a dim, ancient cavern illuminated by soft pink light, emphasizing ultra-realistic textures, cinematic depth of field, and the relationship of trust between the characters.

prompts.title: Social Game Special Move Production Prompt for Nano Banana Pro
prompts.description: A highly detailed, multi-section prompt designed to generate a screen capture of a social game's special move sequence (cut-in, move name, damage display). It strictly requires maintaining the character's original art style from a reference image while inferring dramatic effects, UI, and a random, chuunibyou-style Japanese move name and damage value.

prompts.title: Image-to-Image Workflow for RPG Maker Pixel Maps using Nano Banana
prompts.description: A detailed, multi-step workflow guide for using Nano Banana (specifically Nano Banana 2 or Pro) in image-to-image mode to generate assets like RPG Maker pixel maps or knowledge graphs. It emphasizes using reference images (like RM tiles or game screenshots) to maintain style consistency and provides a sample prompt for generating a dark fantasy RPG map.

prompts.title: 2D Pixel Art Village Map Prompt (ChatGPT)
prompts.description: A prompt used with ChatGPT's image generation feature (not Nano Banana Pro) to create a 2D pixel art map of a village, specifying key locations like a general store, weapon shop, church, and inn, viewed from a 90-degree overhead perspective.

prompts.title: Chainsaw Man Makima Cosplay Psychological Thriller Prompt
prompts.description: A complex, multi-layered JSON prompt for generating a hyper-realistic 8K cosplay image of Makima (Control Devil) from Chainsaw Man. It details her unsettling expression, specific attire (fitted uniform), pose (leaning on a desk, 'Bang' gesture), and technical rendering stack, including emissive materials for the red visceral energy chains and psychological effects like chromatic aberration.

prompts.title: Byzantine Mosaic Style Portrait Prompt
prompts.description: An image generation prompt for creating a triumphant Byzantine mosaic of a subject, rendered in shimmering gold and glass tesserae against a deep cerulean background, depicting the subject holding a barbell plate as a stylized heroic shield.

prompts.title: Obsidian Kintsugi Automaton Style Transfer Prompt
prompts.description: A complex style transfer prompt for Nano Banana Pro, instructing the AI to transform an input photo (Input A) into an 'Obsidian Kintsugi Automaton' state. The transformation requires preserving the exact pose and geometry while reconstructing all surfaces using polished obsidian, aged ivory, clockwork mechanisms, and glowing gold Kintsugi cracks, rendered with dramatic, high-contrast lighting.

prompts.title: Anime Coloring Study: Flat Anime Style with Directional Light
prompts.description: A prompt focusing on achieving a specific flat anime coloring style with directional lighting control. It compares a standard flat style (color, flat shading, one shadow level, general highlight) with a version that explicitly defines the light source direction ('light from the left') to achieve a larger, more defined highlight area.

prompts.title: Digital Painting of Joker in Cowboy Hat
prompts.description: A JSON prompt for generating a highly detailed digital painting of the Joker. The prompt specifies his classic clown makeup, wild green hair, and unique attire: a large purple cowboy hat and a purple suit jacket. The style is oil painting with rich textures, vibrant colors, dramatic lighting, and a dark, chaotic abstract background.

prompts.title: Cyberpunk Spider-Man in Matte Black and Gold

It specifies the materials (brass, glass, polished wood), the mechanisms for each city type (vertical skyline, light grid, rolling waves, spinning towers), and the museum gallery setting and lighting.

It details the structure of the three panels, requiring elements like ingredient specimens, a 3D pop-up diorama, and preparation steps rendered in a 3D designer toy style, all within a museum exhibition setting.

prompts.title: Hyper-Realistic Product Photography and Infographic Prompts for Pepsi

prompts.title: Technical Architectural Blueprint of a Smash Burger
prompts.description: A highly specific prompt for Nano Banana Pro to generate a technical architectural blueprint of a classic smash burger on deep navy drafting paper. The prompt demands hyperrealistic food rendering with precise measurement lines, stack height callouts, and detailed labels connected by glowing CAD lines, showcasing the model's ability to handle complex text and technical fidelity.

prompts.title: Four-Panel Manga: The Magic of Numbers

prompts.title: Monochrome Engraving Portrait Style

prompts.title: Deconstructed Ingredients Visualization
prompts.description: A mathematical-style prompt for Nano Banana to visualize the deconstructed ingredients of a famous international dish, combining elements like miniature toy chefs, floating AR UI panels, and radar charts on a slate serving board.

prompts.title: Caravaggio Meets National Geographic Dissection
prompts.description: A highly descriptive and conceptual prompt for Nano Banana Pro, instructing the generation of a dissected natural object (specimen) lit dramatically like a Caravaggio painting but with the detail of National Geographic photography. It requires specific text overlays and a mood blending science and sacred beauty.

prompts.title: Slow Motion Pour Food Photography Prompt for Nano Banana 2
prompts.description: A detailed prompt for Nano Banana 2 designed to generate ultra high-speed food photography, freezing a dramatic liquid pour over a dish. It specifies cinematic lighting, hyperreal textures, and editorial typography, mimicking the style of Albert Watson and Harold Edgerton.

prompts.title: 2x2 Grid Pop-Up Cookbook Diorama Prompt for Nano Banana

prompts.title: PCB Word Art Schematic for 'Tesla'
prompts.description: A technical prompt for Nano Banana Pro using weighted terms (::) to generate a 2D schematic illustration of the word 'Tesla' constructed entirely from printed circuit board (PCB) traces. It specifies monochrome coloring, technical vector style, and flat lighting, while using a negative prompt to exclude realistic textures or colors.

prompts.title: Complex Machine Deconstruction Blueprint Prompt
prompts.description: A complex, multi-stage Nano Banana prompt designed to generate a 'Kinetic Blueprint' photograph of a complex machine (like a Space Shuttle) being deconstructed into three assembly phases, displayed within partially unfolded triangular acrylic wedges on a drafting table, emphasizing technical art and macro rendering.

prompts.title: The Naturalist Dissection Prompt
prompts.description: A detailed Nano Banana 2 prompt for generating an image of a natural object (like a flower or insect) dissected and pinned open like a specimen, rendered with the lighting style of Caravaggio and the detail of National Geographic photography, emphasizing the contrast between the intact and opened halves.

prompts.title: Template for generating a fictional textbook page
prompts.description: A reusable template prompt for Nano Banana 2 designed to generate a page from a fictional textbook. The user can customize the world setting and subject, ensuring the content is accurate Japanese, avoids font corruption, and is presented as a realistic photo of an open textbook viewed from above.

prompts.title: Object Reasoning Test Prompt for Nano Banana 2
prompts.description: A detailed prompt designed to test the object reasoning and spatial awareness capabilities of image generation models, comparing Nano Banana 2 and Uni-1. The prompt requires specific placement of objects (red cube, yellow sphere, green mug, silver candlestick) and a complex reflection scenario where the green mug is absent from the mirror.

prompts.title: Four-Panel Manga: The Legend of the 5000 Yen Cost

prompts.title: 3x3 Grid Prompt for Lighting Cheatsheet

It requests a 16:9 horizontal composition in the style of ancient historical diagrams and illustrated books, comparing the uniforms of nine officials from the first to the ninth rank. The prompt specifies detailed elements like the embroidered rank badges (Buzi), court beads (Chaozhu), hat ornaments (Dingdai Hualing), and dragon robes (Mangpao), along with explanatory tables and historical context, making it suitable for educational content on Chinese history and culture.

prompts.title: Scientific Theory Visualization: 2D to 3D Extrusion

prompts.title: 20-Panel Cartoon Robot Drawing Guide Prompt

prompts.title: Calculus Symbols as Futuristic Architecture
prompts.description: A short, vague prompt designed to generate a 2x2 grid of four futuristic architectural landmarks. The landmarks are based on important calculus symbols and are set in a utopian solarpunk city, emphasizing clean materials, bright midday lighting, and a sense of scale.

prompts.title: Slide Generation Prompt for Nano Banana Pro
prompts.description: This prompt is used with the 'Slides' feature powered by Nano Banana Pro to automatically generate a presentation. The user specifies the topic and the desired number of slides, and the AI handles the structure, text, diagrams, and design.

prompts.title: Surreal Diorama and Don Quixote Miniature Prompts
prompts.description: Two detailed image generation prompts used with Nano Banana Pro. The first creates a surreal, clinical diorama of a futuristic hatching laboratory emerging from an open vintage book of 'Brave New World.' The second generates a hyper-realistic miniature sculpture diorama of a Spanish landscape and windmill scene from 'Don Quixote' within an open aged book.

prompts.title: 2025 Scrapbook Mosaic Stone Aesthetic
prompts.description: A structured prompt for generating a visual scrapbook or 'Year in Review' using a mosaic stone aesthetic. It lists various memories and provides specific visual descriptions for how each memory should be represented as an inlaid illustration on a textured stone background.

prompts.title: Pop-Up Paper Engineering of Mathematical Symbols
prompts.description: A prompt for Nano Banana Pro requesting a 2x2 grid image featuring four large mathematical symbols (Integral, Sigma, Pi, Klein bottle) constructed as hyper-realistic pop-up paper engineering sculptures on an opened book, emphasizing miniature realism and editorial lighting.

prompts.title: WordPress Blog Setup Diagram Generation Prompt
prompts.description: A simple prompt used to compare ChatGPT Images and Nano Banana Pro, instructing the AI to generate a diagram illustrating the steps for setting up a WordPress blog.

prompts.title: Sushi Kata/Forms Movement Arrangement on a Wooden Board
prompts.description: A creative prompt requesting an image of a long wooden board displaying martial arts movements (kata/forms) represented by arrangements of sushi pieces. The arrangement should show flow, garnishes should indicate energy direction, and wasabi should mark power points.

prompts.title: News Article Diagram Generation
prompts.description: A prompt used to compare Nano Banana Pro and GPT Image 1.5 by instructing the model to visualize a news article into a single slide diagram.

prompts.title: Diagram of ChatGPT 5.2 Features with Japanese Text
prompts.description: A prompt instructing the AI to create a diagram illustrating the features of ChatGPT 5.2 using perfect Japanese fonts, requesting a 16:9 aspect ratio and the inclusion of cute illustrations. This prompt was used to compare the Japanese text rendering capabilities of GPT Image 1.5 and Nano Banana Pro.

prompts.title: Handwritten Notes to Whiteboard Conversion Prompt
prompts.description: A simple text prompt instructing the model to convert messy handwritten notes into a structured, photorealistic image of a whiteboard, useful for digitizing and organizing information.

prompts.title: Text-Heavy Presentation Slide Generation
prompts.description: A prompt designed to test the models' ability to handle Japanese text and layout by demanding the creation of a dense, 16:9 presentation slide (Ponchi-e slide) filled with the provided text, ensuring no empty space.

prompts.title: Technical Schematic Overlay Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt used to test another model's capability against Nano Banana, generating a high-resolution, realistic photograph with a mixed-media overlay of white, hand-drawn technical schematics and engineering diagrams, creating an educational infographic aesthetic.

prompts.title: Building Construction Visualization
prompts.description: A simple prompt instructing the AI to visualize the construction phases of a building.

prompts.title: Minimalist Plasma Core Data Sheet
prompts.description: A prompt for creating a minimalist, segmented experimental 'plasma core' data sheet, requiring the use of uploaded images for style consistency and incorporating data readings and artistic segmentation into the final technical document image.

prompts.title: Font Generation Inspired by Uploaded Images
prompts.description: A conceptual prompt instructing the AI to analyze uploaded images (a dinosaur, a tank, a kinetic sculpture) and borrow elements from their shapes and aspects to create new, unique fonts. The output is requested as a 3x3 grid showcasing the new, inspired fonts.

prompts.title: Absurd Patentable Invention Generator
prompts.description: A multi-step prompt designed for Nano Banana Pro to analyze three uploaded random objects, combine their features into a single absurd but patentable invention, and then output a 2x2 grid featuring technical patent drawings, a glossy product render, and a detailed marketing explanation.

prompts.title: Educational Image Prompt: Adverbs of Frequency
prompts.description: A prompt used to generate a visual aid illustrating adverbs of frequency, likely intended for educational use on a blackboard or similar setting.

prompts.title: Isometric 3D Miniature Stadium Infographic
prompts.description: A prompt for generating a detailed isometric 3D infographic rendering of the Camp Nou stadium in Barcelona, emphasizing miniature scale, architectural detail, and a clean, modern design style.

prompts.title: Generating a Graphic Record of Debussy's Songs
prompts.description: A prompt designed for Nano Banana Pro to create a graphic record (grareco) summarizing the trajectory of French composer Debussy's art songs, including biographical and chronological details, intended for use in a concert program.

prompts.title: Rainbow Illustration Description
prompts.description: A descriptive text about the physics of rainbows, focusing on how water refracts light at a specific angle (42°). This text was likely used as a prompt to generate an illustration of a rainbow.

prompts.title: AI Overview Critical Analysis Prompt
prompts.description: A text prompt for Gemini Nano Banana Pro (used with the 'Thinking' feature) designed to critically analyze a screenshot of an AI Overview answer. The instruction is to overlay the analysis with red scribble remarks, useful for evaluating and annotating AI output accuracy.

prompts.title: Isometric 3D Cartoon Scene of a City
prompts.description: A prompt for creating an isometric miniature 3D cartoon scene of a specified city, including details like AQI and temperature. The city name is parameterized for customization.

prompts.title: Screen Time Digital Town Visualization Prompt
prompts.description: A highly detailed, multi-section Chinese prompt for Nano Banana Pro that visualizes the user's screen time data as a miniature digital town (Isometric City). The prompt dictates the style (Polymer Clay/Jelly Resin), the structure (building height corresponds to usage time), the city's ecosystem (data flow, NPCs like mail carriers and like-sprites), and the final rendering specifications.

prompts.title: Four-Panel Guide for Drawing a Cartoon Duck
prompts.description: A structured, multi-panel prompt designed to generate a step-by-step visual guide for drawing a simple cartoon duck, useful for educational or instructional content.

prompts.title: 3D Diorama of Ahmedabad Landmark
prompts.description: A prompt for Nano Banana Pro to create a hyper-realistic 3D diorama-style miniature model of a specific landmark, in this case, Ahmedabad. The prompt demands proportional accuracy, tiny realistic elements (street lamps, native trees), a soft white background, and prominent text labeling the city and including a national flag.

prompts.title: ChatGPT v5.1 vs v5.2 Evolution Infographic Prompt
prompts.description: A detailed prompt for Nano Banana Pro (Gemini) to create a cute, comic-style infographic comparing ChatGPT v5.1 (warm dialogue, foundation) and v5.2 (accuracy, power enhancement). It is designed to incorporate an uploaded reference image of a character/avatar who acts as the presenter/explainer in the diagram.

prompts.title: Convert Image to Editable PPTX with Object Separation Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt used to convert an image generated by Nano Banana Pro into a PowerPoint (pptx) file where all text is editable and all visual objects are separated and movable.

prompts.title: Convert Image to Editable PowerPoint Slide Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt used with GPT-5.2 to convert an image generated by Nano Banana Pro into a fully editable PowerPoint (pptx) slide. The prompt instructs the model to preserve text as editable elements and use cropped images/graphs from the original source.

prompts.title: Isometric Vertical Timeline Prompt (Garage to Futuristic Peak)
prompts.description: A concise prompt for generating an isometric, frameless vertical timeline illustration. The scene depicts the evolution of a company, starting from a humble garage and culminating in a futuristic peak, all contained within a single vertical composition.

prompts.title: OOTD (Outfit of the Day) Fashion Diagram Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt for Nano Banana Pro (Prompt #12) designed to generate an 'OOTD (Outfit of the Day) Fashion Diagram'.

prompts.title: Forcing Left-Handed Writing
prompts.description: A prompt designed to trick the AI (Nano Banana Pro) into generating a person writing with their left hand by specifying the pen is held by the hand on the right side of the frame, thus avoiding the common AI bias toward right-handed subjects.

prompts.title: Microscopic Pencil Tip to Proton Zoom
prompts.description: This entry references and adapts an original prompt by @umesh_ai, which asks the AI to visualize a pencil tip seen through a microscope. The user adapted this concept to a ballpoint pen and created a workflow for generating four zoom states, down to a single proton. The extracted content is the original prompt.

prompts.title: Explain Tesla Coil Science
prompts.description: A text prompt asking the AI to explain the exact science, workings, and reasons behind a plasma glass Tesla experiment, based on an uploaded screenshot from a YouTube channel.

prompts.title: Informative Page Generation Prompt (Professor Hello Kitty)
prompts.description: A prompt instructing the AI to generate an informative, single-page image explaining the instructions for a process, presented in the style of 'Professor Hello Kitty' teaching.

prompts.title: Predictive K-Line Chart Extension for Stock Trends
prompts.description: A prompt used for entertainment purposes to instruct an image generation model to extend a provided stock trend chart (K-line chart) by drawing the predicted trend for the next 10 days using dashed lines.

prompts.title: Labeled Diagram of a Human Cell (Comparison Prompt)
prompts.description: A prompt used to test the accuracy and detail of image generation models by requesting a fully labeled diagram of a human cell with a minimum of 10 precise and accurate labels. This prompt is used in a comparison context against another model.

prompts.title: Data Visualization Based on Storytelling with Data Principles
prompts.description: A simple instruction used to enhance data visualization generation by explicitly referencing the principles from the book 'Storytelling with Data,' resulting in visualizations that closely resemble the book's examples.

prompts.title: Professional Infographic Generation Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt for Nano Banana Pro to generate a professional knowledge infographic based on a specific topic. It specifies requirements for content (3-5 core points), visual elements (icons, flowcharts, data visualization), structure (clear hierarchy, smooth visual guidance), text (accurate Chinese title/description), style (professional, coordinated colors, modern flat design), and output quality (4K resolution).

prompts.title: Microscopic View of a Subject
prompts.description: A concise prompt for Nano Banana Pro designed to generate ultra-realistic, sharp images of common subjects as if viewed through a microscope. It explicitly excludes the microscope apparatus itself, focusing only on the detailed texture of the subject.

prompts.title: 2x2 Grid Car Development Phases
prompts.description: A concise Nano Banana Pro prompt requesting a 2x2 grid illustrating the four distinct development phases of a car: initial sketch, clay model, early prototype, and the final production release.

prompts.title: Time Progression Image Generation Prompt
prompts.description: This prompt for Nano Banana Pro is designed to generate images that predict or show scenes at different points in time, specifically 5 minutes before, 30 minutes after, 1 hour after, and 2 hours after the current moment.

prompts.title: Infographic/Diagram Generation Prompt for Nano Banana Pro
prompts.description: A prompt designed to generate a visual diagram or infographic for an X (Twitter) post using Nano Banana Pro. It specifies the content structure, focusing on three reasons why designers fail, and asks the model to create an image based on these conditions.

prompts.title: Colorful 'ABC of Jobs' Educational Poster
prompts.description: A simple prompt for generating a colorful educational poster for children, featuring the alphabet (A-Z) with cute illustrations representing different jobs, designed with a clean layout and bold letters.

prompts.title: Museum-Grade 3D Diorama Poster for Historical Events
prompts.description: An adaptation of the 3D diorama poster prompt, specifically tailored for generating museum-grade posters of real historical events or significant moments (e.g., SpaceX landing, Messi winning the World Cup). It requires the AI to research the event, capture the atmosphere and details, and present the result with a sophisticated layout and relevant historical text.

prompts.title: Map of Turkey Made of Local Foods
prompts.description: A creative prompt to generate a map of Turkey where each city is visually constructed entirely out of its most famous local food, requiring careful geographical accuracy and realistic food textures.

prompts.title: Educational Prompt for High School Math Formulas on a Chalkboard
prompts.description: A prompt designed to generate a visually appealing and easy-to-understand image of high school entrance exam math formulas written on a chalkboard with color-coding for effective studying.

prompts.title: Tip for Using Nano Banana Pro: Adding Examples for Better Understanding
prompts.description: A quick tip for improving the output of Nano Banana Pro by adding the instruction to explain concepts with three concrete examples, leading to a dramatic increase in comprehension.

prompts.title: Hyper-realistic Transportation Evolution Panoramic Landscape Prompt
prompts.description: A detailed, hyper-realistic image generation prompt for Nano Banana Pro, designed to create a panoramic illustration depicting the chronological evolution of human transportation along a river, from ancient canoes to futuristic space elevators, emphasizing 8K detail and cinematic lighting.

prompts.title: Annotating the 'Attention Is All You Need' Paper
prompts.description: A prompt designed for the Nano Banana Pro model to help users understand the 'Attention Is All You Need' (Transformer) paper. It instructs the AI to provide assistance, circle important content (like figures or formulas), and add explanatory annotations in a hand-drawn style for better comprehension.

prompts.title: Nano Banana Pro Prompt Technique for Beginners
prompts.description: A prompt technique for using Nano Banana Pro to simplify complex tasks by requesting an explanation in three steps for beginners, which can triple the speed of creating meeting materials.

prompts.title: Anime-style Graphic Recording from Web Search Results
prompts.description: This prompt is designed for Gemini to first search the web for information about a specific company or topic, and then use Nano Banana Pro to summarize that information into an anime-style graphic recording (grareco), narrated by a fun character like a cat. The process is claimed to take less than a minute.

prompts.title: Infographic Generation based on Real-Time News Data
prompts.description: A text prompt instructing an AI model (Nano Banana Pro, connected to Google Search) to generate an infographic based on real-time data and news from the previous week, specifically concerning the readiness of Iran and Israel for conflict.

prompts.title: Hand-Drawn Isometric Schematic Diagram Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt template for Nano Banana Pro used to create a hand-drawn, isometric schematic diagram of any object or concept, with examples provided for the principle of aircraft takeoff and the inside of the human brain.

prompts.title: Isometric Schematic Diagram of Notre Dame Prompt
prompts.description: A simple text prompt instructing the AI to create a hand-drawn isometric schematic diagram of the Notre Dame cathedral.

prompts.title: Academic Paper Annotation Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt designed to assist in reading academic papers by instructing the AI to generate a visual representation of a paper page with detailed, hand-drawn style annotations, including circles, arrows, and highlighters, to mark important content and images.

prompts.title: Two-Step Tier List Generation Prompt
prompts.description: A two-part prompt sequence used to generate a visual tier list. The first prompt generates the structured JSON data for the tier list, and the second prompt uses that data to generate the corresponding image in a classic style with representative thumbnails.

prompts.title: Paper Annotation and Review Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt instructing Nano Banana Pro to generate an image of a printed paper (like a thesis or article) heavily annotated with handwritten Chinese notes, doodles, and clip art in red ink, specifically aimed at explaining the principles and details of the paper to a university-level audience.

prompts.title: Novel Optical Illusion Generation
prompts.description: A meta-prompt challenging the AI to generate a completely new optical illusion. It requires the AI to analyze the elements of typical illusions, avoid common tropes (impossible structures, faces/vases), and base the novel illusion around the specific word 'fofr'.

prompts.title: Behind-the-Scenes Generation Prompt
prompts.description: A simple, direct prompt used to generate a 'behind-the-scenes' image based on a provided reference scene, specifically demonstrated here using a scene from the movie 'The Exorcist'.

prompts.title: Nano Banana Pro Quality Enhancement Keywords
prompts.description: A list of keywords and techniques for Nano Banana Pro (and similar image generation AIs) to enhance image quality, lighting, character appeal, and artistic style, including the use of emphasis syntax and negative prompts.

prompts.title: Nano Banana Pro Prompt Structure and Visual Elements
prompts.description: A comprehensive guide based on Google's official recommendations for effective Nano Banana Pro prompts, outlining a basic structural framework and providing specific examples for camera shots, lighting, material textures, and artistic styles. This is a meta-prompt structure, not a single executable prompt.

prompts.title: Loch Ness Monster Visual Description and Generation
prompts.description: A meta-prompt instructing the AI to first synthesize all known information about the Loch Ness Monster into a detailed visual description, and then use that description to generate a photorealistic, landscape-oriented image of the creature.

prompts.title: Generating Exchange Volume Change Image
prompts.description: A prompt designed for a work scenario, instructing the AI to generate a visual representation of the trading volume changes for major exchanges this year, emphasizing clarity and intuitiveness.

prompts.title: Scientific Ultra-Macro Insect Capture Prompt
prompts.description: An extremely detailed, technical prompt designed for generating a hyper-realistic, scientific ultra-macro photograph of a predatory wasp carrying a bright green caterpillar. It specifies the goal, subject, pose, framing, and includes meticulous camera and post-processing settings (apochromatic macro lens, f/11, 1/8000 shutter, cross-polarized lighting, focus stacking) to achieve entomology documentation realism.

prompts.title: Watercolor Travel Map Illustration Prompt
prompts.description: A simple prompt instructing the model to generate a watercolor travel-map illustration of cities.

prompts.title: Safety Hazard Analysis and Visualization
prompts.description: A prompt designed for an AI capable of image analysis and re-generation. It asks the AI to analyze a provided image for specific safety hazards (fire, tripping, electrical), regenerate the room in black and white, and overlay bright neon red bounding boxes and text labels identifying each risk found.

prompts.title: Evolutionary Bridge Cinematic Shot Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt designed to create a cinematic, high-resolution shot of a single, winding bridge that seamlessly transitions through different architectural eras—from Roman stone to futuristic composite material—with era-appropriate travelers and weathering, set in a misty valley with soft morning light.

prompts.title: JSON prompt for construction site AR blueprint overlay
prompts.description: A structured JSON prompt for generating an editorial-style image of a construction site, where an uploaded subject holds up a holographic architectural blueprint projection over the unfinished structure, detailing the scene, subject, overlay object, and technical camera settings.

prompts.title: Hāng to Lā (Good to Bad) Rating Infographic Prompt
prompts.description: A complex Chinese prompt for Nano Banana Pro designed to generate a 'Hāng to Lā' (Good to Bad) rating infographic using a Bento Grid layout. It instructs the AI to research a user-specified topic (e.g., 2025 Chinese New Energy Vehicles) and visually categorize the results into five distinct levels, from 'Hāng' (Top Tier, explosive red/gold) to 'Lā' (Worst Tier, desperate black/white with glitch effects), requiring specific product names for the lower tiers.

prompts.title: Nano Banana Pro Decision Making Prompt
prompts.description: This is a powerful prompt for the Nano Banana Pro AI, designed to help users make purchasing decisions for any product category. It generates a four-quadrant image comparing different product types, allowing the user to instantly become an expert in categories like beverages, electric vehicles, bicycles, or coffee shops, generating high-interest, trending content.

prompts.title: Sgraffito Mechanical Blueprint of NVIDIA 4090 GPU
prompts.description: A prompt for generating a detailed mechanical blueprint of an NVIDIA 4090 GPU, rendered in the sgraffito art style. This is likely an image generation prompt used with Gemini Nano Banana Pro.

prompts.title: Japanese prompt for transforming a cooking photo into a scrapbook collage
prompts.description: A detailed Japanese system prompt for the Nano Banana Pro agent (V1.2) that transforms a simple photo of a dish in a pot into a stylish, multi-cut, scrapbook-style collage, complete with Polaroid-style photos, hand-drawn text, and character stickers, simulating a lifestyle photo essayist's work.

prompts.title: AI Solves Assignment from Handwriting and Blank Paper
prompts.description: This tweet describes a scenario where the 'nano banana pro' AI model was given a user's handwriting sample and an empty paper, and it successfully completed the user's assignment in one attempt. This implies a multimodal prompt where the user provided both a visual input (handwriting/style reference) and potentially an implicit or explicit instruction (the assignment itself) to be solved and written out in the provided style.

prompts.title: Multi-Font Text Generation and Control
prompts.description: Two prompts demonstrating Nano Banana Pro's advanced text control capabilities, allowing the generation of a single string using multiple specified Japanese and English font styles, and even assigning different fonts to specific words within the string.

prompts.title: Surreal deep sea storage illusion prompt
prompts.description: A prompt for Nano Banana Pro that creates a surreal illusion of a subject lifting a wave like a carpet to reveal an object lying deep underneath, suggesting a transition from cloud storage to deep sea storage.

prompts.title: Prompt for clearing handwritten answers from a test image for reuse
prompts.description: This prompt is designed for use with an AI tool like Nano Banana Pro to process an image of a completed test paper. The goal is to remove all handwritten answers, specifically text within parentheses, squares, and red circles (like corrections or scores), leaving a blank test template that can be solved again repeatedly.

prompts.title: 5-Step Marketing Flowchart Diagram Generator
prompts.description: A detailed prompt for generating a clean, business-oriented circular flowchart diagram illustrating the 5 steps of the marketing process. It specifies a simple white background, blue accent colors, precise Japanese text rendering, and a layout suitable for presentation slides.

prompts.title: Blender 3D Viewport Style Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt designed to render an image in the style of a Blender 3D Viewport, specifically using Solid Shading mode with Wireframe Overlay, visible Armature bones in X-Ray view, Object Outlines, and the 3D cursor grid floor.

prompts.title: Kids' How-To Poster Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt designed to generate a cute, illustrative poster for children explaining how to tie shoes, featuring simple steps, bright colors, and friendly illustrations.

prompts.title: Graphic Recording (GraReco) Prompt for Nano Banana Pro
prompts.description: A detailed system prompt instructing Nano Banana Pro to act as a skilled 'Graphic Recorder' (GraReco). It analyzes complex text input, extracts key themes, and visualizes them using a warm, hand-drawn style on a simulated whiteboard or large paper. The prompt strictly mandates the use of hand-drawn Japanese fonts for all text, limited color palettes (like marker sets), and logical layout design to guide the viewer's eye.

prompts.title: Ukiyo-e Teacup Head Infographic Prompt
prompts.description: A simple, effective prompt for Nano Banana Pro to generate an infographic using a specific, highly stylized aesthetic: Ukiyo-e (Japanese woodblock print) combined with the 'Teacup Head' character style.

prompts.title: Accurate Academic Diagram Generation Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt for Nano Banana Pro designed to accurately visualize complex academic principles from a research paper into a diagram or figure. It emphasizes using Japanese text for all labels and prioritizing accuracy and academic language when translating specialized terminology.

prompts.title: High-Contrast Thermal X-Ray Render of Android Robot
prompts.description: A detailed image generation prompt for creating a high-contrast, scientific studio render of the Google Android robot. It uses a thermal X-ray aesthetic to reveal internal architecture with a vibrant heatmap gradient, suitable for futuristic, clinical visuals.

prompts.title: Isometric Pictogram Diagram Prompt for Nano Banana Pro
prompts.description: A prompt designed for Nano Banana Pro to generate diagrams using isometric perspective (viewed from an angle above) and pictograms (simple symbols). This is useful for visualizing flows and procedures, demonstrated here with a prompt for anger management steps.

prompts.title: Deconstructed Apple Vision Pro Comparison Photography
prompts.description: An image generation prompt for creating a split-layout, deconstructed comparison photograph of the Apple Vision Pro. The left side shows the complete device, and the right side features the fully disassembled internal components arranged in a precise knolling geometric layout with a minimalist industrial aesthetic.

prompts.title: Miniature 3D City with Live Weather Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt for generating an isometric, miniature 3D city render of Puri, India, incorporating live weather elements, suitable for AI illustration and digital art.

prompts.title: Generating Visuals from Real-Time Korean News
prompts.description: A prompt for the Nano Banana Pro tool, instructing it to generate a representative visual image based on real-time news information originating from South Korea. This is a functional prompt for content creation based on current events.

prompts.title: VFX Comparison Image Prompt (Before/After) for Nano Banana Pro
prompts.description: A complex, structured prompt for Nano Banana Pro or Seedream 4.5 to generate a split-screen VFX comparison image. The left side shows the photorealistic 'finished shot' based on a theme, and the right side shows the 'green screen shooting' setup with the exact same subject and pose, mimicking the look of early 2000s Japanese film VFX before-and-afters.

prompts.title: High-Quality Flat Design Slide Generation Prompt
prompts.description: A detailed prompt for Nano Banana Pro (used here in Manus Slide feature) to generate high-quality slides instantly. The style emphasizes a simple, clean, flat design with uniform black outlines, pastel accent colors, rounded shapes, and a focus on diagrammatic composition (Venn diagrams, bar graphs, speech bubbles) suitable for students or social media.

The prompt specifies an extreme high-angle, bird's-eye view with wide-angle distortion, a peace sign pose, and a surreal background where clouds spell out the word 'BeautyVerse'.

The prompt includes detailed descriptions of her attire, accessories, background objects (like an electric guitar), and specific lighting conditions (golden hour).

prompts.title: Pedestrian Markings as Personal Silhouette

prompts.title: Multiple Close-up Photos of Sydney Sweeney and Ana de Armas
prompts.description: A complex, multi-part structured prompt designed to generate four distinct, ultra-close-up photographs featuring two different celebrities (Ana de Armas and Sydney Sweeney) in varying poses, outfits, environments, and photographic styles, ranging from casual athleisure to high-fashion glam.

prompts.title: Intimate Low-Light Bedroom Portrait with Vintage Film Aesthetic

prompts.title: Photorealistic Winter Fashion Prompt (Ana de Armas)

The prompt specifies her appearance, attire (faux-fur jacket, electric orange leggings, Moon Boots), a deep squat pose with prominent rear view, the environment (dense winter forest, heavy snow), and specific camera and lighting settings (low angle, soft diffused overcast daylight, 3:4 vertical aspect ratio).

The user is impressed by the AI's accurate depiction of the bicycle mechanics.

prompts.title: Cool Palette, Bold Energy, Wide Angles

The prompt uses rich metaphorical language—comparing the subject to a 'sour pickle' or 'crushed soda can'—to contrast their polished, elite exterior (gold-plated office, black-speak) with their inner turmoil, aiming for a visual representation of emotional stability masking madness.

prompts.title: Cinematic Talk Show Portrait (Emilia Clarke Inspired)
