prompts.title: Prompt for 80s TV Style Villainess Character Design
prompts.description: A prompt used with Nano Banana Pro to generate a photorealistic image of a female villain leader from a Tokusatsu (special effects) TV show, rendered in an 80s TV style. The key concept, 'Chaos,' was chosen by the AI based on the user's past conversation history.

prompts.title: Eyecatch Image Generation from Video Transcript
prompts.description: A user generated an eyecatch image using Nano Banana based on a video transcript, noting that image generation AI might replace manual creation in Canva.

prompts.title: Talk-Show Style Celebrity Interview Photo
prompts.description: A detailed prompt for generating an ultra-realistic, cinematic talk-show style photo featuring a host and a specified celebrity. It focuses on precise composition, lighting, and facial accuracy to achieve a premium 'Netflix documentary interview' aesthetic.

prompts.title: Dan-Style Cover Image Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt designed to create cover images in the style of 'Dan' (likely a popular creator or style), shared for use with Youmind, which integrates Nano Banana Pro, allowing users to create visually striking cover art.

prompts.title: YouTube Thumbnail: Trump vs. Chatham House Reaction
prompts.description: A prompt for generating a high-impact YouTube thumbnail image with a specific visual structure: a triumphant Trump cutout on the right and a shocked corporate figure (Chatham House head) on the left, overlaid with the text 'THEY CONFESSED'. This is a political/news-style graphic prompt.

prompts.title: Thumbnail Generation Prompt for Sales Content (Brain/Tips/Note)
prompts.description: A structured system prompt designed to be used with Nano Banana Pro to generate high-quality, 'sellable' eye-catching thumbnails for online content platforms like Brain, Tips, and Note. The prompt defines the role as a professional graphic designer and provides a detailed design style guide, including layout, color scheme, typography, and required input fields for customization.

prompts.title: YouTube Thumbnail Prompt: Political Split Screen
prompts.description: A prompt designed to create a high-contrast YouTube thumbnail with a split-screen layout. It features two political figures (Trump and Mark Carney) with specific expressions and background elements, overlaid with high-contrast text.

prompts.title: Political YouTube Thumbnail (Trump and Document)
prompts.description: A prompt for generating a powerful, high-impact YouTube thumbnail featuring a close-up of Trump on the right side with a confident smirk, juxtaposed with an official UK House of Lords document on the left that contains text in bright neon green, creating a dynamic and high-contrast visual.

prompts.title: Moody Cinematic Portrait Prompt for AI Image Generation
prompts.description: This is an image generation prompt designed to create a moody, dramatic cinematic portrait with intense side lighting and a thriller-like gaze. The prompt specifies a high-contrast, high-detail aesthetic suitable for generating striking visual art.

prompts.title: Character Riding Pegasus Fantasy Illustration Prompt
prompts.description: A detailed image generation prompt for creating a dynamic fantasy illustration of a character riding a Pegasus, based on an uploaded image. It specifies the character's pose, the Pegasus's movement, cinematic lighting, and constraints to ensure a high-quality, action-packed anime-style scene with a 16:9 aspect ratio.

prompts.title: Youtube Thumbnail Concept: The New Weapon
prompts.description: A prompt for generating a YouTube thumbnail concept split 50/50 between a grayscale 'War' side and a high-saturation 'Fusion' side, with a central cutout of Trump acting as the divider, featuring large yellow text reading 'THE NEW WEAPON'.

prompts.title: Air France ad fix prompt
prompts.description: A prompt designed to fix a perceived terrible Air France advertisement by generating a new, more appealing image. The prompt specifies a highly detailed, cinematic, and dramatic scene featuring an Air France A380 flying over a futuristic, neon-lit Paris at night, emphasizing high-quality rendering and dramatic lighting.

prompts.title: Split-Screen YouTube Thumbnail: JD Vance Political Commentary
prompts.description: A detailed prompt for generating a high-contrast, split-screen YouTube thumbnail designed for political commentary, featuring a heroic portrait of JD Vance contrasted with a chaotic, shattered glass overlay representing political division.

prompts.title: Tiny People, Giant Problem Diorama Prompt
prompts.description: A short, customizable prompt for generating a miniature diorama image where tiny people or characters struggle with an oversized everyday object, emphasizing exaggerated scale contrast and macro lens perspective.

prompts.title: Architectural Diorama Coin Art Grid Prompt
prompts.description: A detailed image generation prompt for a 2x2 grid featuring ancient currency that has been transformed into architectural dioramas, blending archaeological photography style with distinct cultural elements and sharp focus.

prompts.title: Corporate Tech/Anime Eyecatch Image Prompt
prompts.description: A detailed JSON prompt for Nano Banana Pro to generate a visually striking eyecatch image (thumbnail/banner) combining Corporate Tech design with Japanese Anime art. It uses a diagonal split layout, with the left side dedicated to typography (headline, sub-headline, CTA) in black and yellow, and the right side featuring a cute, futuristic anime girl illustration.

prompts.title: Blade Runner Opening Style Image
prompts.description: A simple prompt asking Nano Banana Pro to generate an image in the style of the Blade Runner opening sequence.

prompts.title: Cognitive Science-Based High-CTR Thumbnail Design Prompt
prompts.description: A sophisticated system prompt designed for Nano Banana Pro to create high Click-Through Rate (CTR) thumbnails based on principles of cognitive science (neuroscience, psychology, behavioral economics). It instructs the AI to adopt the persona of an expert art director, analyze input text, and follow a detailed thinking process (Thinking Mode) before drawing, focusing on facial activation, pop-out effects, and minimizing cognitive load. It includes specific design and typography instructions.

prompts.title: Advanced Two-Step Prompting Strategy for Nano Banana Pro Thumbnails
prompts.description: This tweet outlines an advanced, two-step prompting strategy to significantly improve the quality of AI output, specifically for generating YouTube thumbnails using Nano Banana Pro. The strategy involves first asking a powerful LLM (like GPT-5.2) to systematically summarize the best practices, terminology, and constraints for creating Nano Banana Pro prompts (creating a 'map'). Then, the user asks the LLM to generate the final, specific prompt based on that established system and the user's requirements, resulting in much more consistent and targeted output.

prompts.title: Hyper-Real 16K Documentary Shot: The Sun Flickers Off
prompts.description: A highly conceptual and technical prompt requesting a hyper-realistic, 16K documentary-style shot capturing the impossible moment the sun briefly turns off. The prompt demands scientific accuracy in lighting physics, atmospheric scattering, and documentary realism (handheld camera, micro-grain), focusing on the terrifying, instantaneous collapse and violent return of daylight and shadows.

prompts.title: Thumbnail Text Decoration Enhancement Prompt
prompts.description: A prompt designed to add high-quality text decoration and a sense of luxury to an existing image, typically used for enhancing thumbnails or visual headers.

prompts.title: Cyber-Horror YouTube Thumbnail Generator
prompts.description: A detailed system prompt for Nano Banana Pro to generate high-click-through-rate horror-themed YouTube thumbnails. The AI acts as a horror concept artist, focusing on creating a cyber-horror aesthetic, emphasizing the uncanny gap between the 'Nano Banana' name and its 'super-performance AI' nature. It includes specific instructions for composition, lighting, and integrating a reference character as a terrified witness.

prompts.title: Simple YouTube Thumbnail Generation Prompt
prompts.description: A very simple prompt used to generate a YouTube thumbnail with Nano Banana Pro. The prompt specifies the purpose and the required text, with an optional addition of a key visual (a cute cat) to customize the output.

prompts.title: MrBeast-style thumbnail about Epstein files
prompts.description: An English prompt that generates a MrBeast-style YouTube thumbnail featuring Donald Trump revealing what’s in the Epstein files.

prompts.title: YouTube thumbnail introducing Nano Banana Pro
prompts.description: A structured prompt to make a YouTube thumbnail where a man introduces Nano Banana Pro, with dynamic glossy fonts and Japanese text aimed at business viewers.

prompts.title: YouTube thumbnail using a specific character for chat stream
prompts.description: A Japanese prompt to create a YouTube thumbnail using a given character, with only the upper body, a cheerful pose, large ‘雑談’ text with furigana, and a simple pop background with stripes.

prompts.title: High-conversion YouTube thumbnail by genius designer-psychologist
prompts.description: A Japanese prompt asking Nano Banana Pro to design the highest-performing YouTube thumbnail possible from the perspective of a genius thumbnail designer and psychologist.
